  1: /// Represents a node inside the Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO).
  2: /// Implements a linearized, GPU-friendly design stored in a flat arena array.
  3: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
  4: pub enum SvoNode {
  5:     /// Leaf node storing actual voxel attributes
  6:     Leaf {
  7:         voxel_type: u8,
  8:         color: u32,
  9:         light_rgb: [u8; 3],
 10:         face_occlusion: u8,
 11:     },
 12:     /// Internal parent node directing traversal to 8 children
 13:     Internal {
 14:         /// Base index in the arena vector where the 8 children nodes are stored contiguously.
 15:         child_base_index: u32,
 16:         /// Bitmask where bit `i` represents if child `i` is non-empty (1) or empty air (0).
 17:         child_mask: u8,
 18:     },
 19: }
 20: 
 21: /// The Sparse Voxel Octree aggregate root entity.
 22: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
 23: pub struct SparseVoxelOctree {
 24:     pub root: usize,
 25:     pub nodes: Vec<SvoNode>,
 26:     pub depth: u32,
 27:     pub world_size: f32,
 28: }
 29: 
 30: impl SparseVoxelOctree {
 31:     /// Creates a new empty Sparse Voxel Octree.
 32:     pub fn new(depth: u32, world_size: f32) -> Self {
 33:         let root_node = SvoNode::Leaf {
 34:             voxel_type: 0,
 35:             color: 0,
 36:             light_rgb: [0; 3],
 37:             face_occlusion: 0,
 38:         };
 39:         Self {
 40:             root: 0,
 41:             nodes: vec![root_node],
 42:             depth,
 43:             world_size,
 44:         }
 45:     }
 46: 
 47:     /// Checks if the SVO is entirely empty (air).
 48:     pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
 49:         match self.nodes[self.root] {
 50:             SvoNode::Leaf { voxel_type, .. } => voxel_type == 0,
 51:             SvoNode::Internal { child_mask, .. } => child_mask == 0,
 52:         }
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     /// Queries the SVO for voxel attributes at integer coordinates `(x, y, z)`.
 56:     pub fn get(&self, x: u32, y: u32, z: u32) -> Option<(u8, u32, [u8; 3], u8)> {
 57:         let max_coord = 1 << self.depth;
 58:         if x >= max_coord || y >= max_coord || z >= max_coord {
 59:             return None;
 60:         }
 61:         self.get_recursive(self.root, x, y, z, self.depth)
 62:     }
 63: 
 64:     fn get_recursive(
 65:         &self,
 66:         node_idx: usize,
 67:         x: u32,
 68:         y: u32,
 69:         z: u32,
 70:         depth: u32,
 71:     ) -> Option<(u8, u32, [u8; 3], u8)> {
 72:         if node_idx >= self.nodes.len() {
 73:             return None;
 74:         }
 75: 
 76:         match self.nodes[node_idx] {
 77:             SvoNode::Leaf {
 78:                 voxel_type,
 79:                 color,
 80:                 light_rgb,
 81:                 face_occlusion,
 82:             } => Some((voxel_type, color, light_rgb, face_occlusion)),
 83:             SvoNode::Internal {
 84:                 child_base_index,
 85:                 child_mask,
 86:             } => {
 87:                 if depth == 0 {
 88:                     return None;
 89:                 }
 90: 
 91:                 let bit = depth - 1;
 92:                 let octant_x = (x >> bit) & 1;
 93:                 let octant_y = (y >> bit) & 1;
 94:                 let octant_z = (z >> bit) & 1;
 95:                 let octant_idx = (octant_z << 2) | (octant_y << 1) | octant_x;
 96: 
 97:                 // Check if the octant is active in the child mask
 98:                 if (child_mask & (1 << octant_idx)) == 0 {
 99:                     return Some((0, 0, [0; 3], 0)); // Empty air
100:                 }
101: 
102:                 let child_node_idx = child_base_index as usize + octant_idx as usize;
103:                 let mask = (1 << bit) - 1;
104:                 self.get_recursive(child_node_idx, x & mask, y & mask, z & mask, depth - 1)
105:             }
106:         }
107:     }
108: 
109:     /// Sets voxel attributes at coordinate `(x, y, z)`. Splits nodes and collapses uniform subtrees recursively.
110:     pub fn set(
111:         &mut self,
112:         x: u32,
113:         y: u32,
114:         z: u32,
115:         voxel_type: u8,
116:         color: u32,
117:         light_rgb: [u8; 3],
118:         face_occlusion: u8,
119:     ) {
120:         let max_coord = 1 << self.depth;
121:         if x >= max_coord || y >= max_coord || z >= max_coord {
122:             return;
123:         }
124:         self.set_recursive(
125:             self.root,
126:             x,
127:             y,
128:             z,
129:             self.depth,
130:             voxel_type,
131:             color,
132:             light_rgb,
133:             face_occlusion,
134:         );
135:     }
136: 
137:     fn set_recursive(
138:         &mut self,
139:         node_idx: usize,
140:         x: u32,
141:         y: u32,
142:         z: u32,
143:         depth: u32,
144:         v_type: u8,
145:         col: u32,
146:         ll: [u8; 3],
147:         fo: u8,
148:     ) {
149:         match self.nodes[node_idx] {
150:             SvoNode::Leaf {
151:                 voxel_type,
152:                 color,
153:                 light_rgb,
154:                 face_occlusion,
155:             } => {
156:                 if voxel_type == v_type && color == col && light_rgb == ll && face_occlusion == fo {
157:                     return;
158:                 }
159: 
160:                 if depth == 0 {
161:                     self.nodes[node_idx] = SvoNode::Leaf {
162:                         voxel_type: v_type,
163:                         color: col,
164:                         light_rgb: ll,
165:                         face_occlusion: fo,
166:                     };
167:                     return;
168:                 }
169: 
170:                 // Split leaf node
171:                 let child_base_index = self.nodes.len() as u32;
172:                 let child_mask = if voxel_type == 0 { 0 } else { 0xFF };
173: 
174:                 for _ in 0..8 {
175:                     self.nodes.push(SvoNode::Leaf {
176:                         voxel_type,
177:                         color,
178:                         light_rgb,
179:                         face_occlusion,
180:                     });
181:                 }
182: 
183:                 self.nodes[node_idx] = SvoNode::Internal {
184:                     child_base_index,
185:                     child_mask,
186:                 };
187: 
188:                 self.set_recursive(node_idx, x, y, z, depth, v_type, col, ll, fo);
189:             }
190:             SvoNode::Internal {
191:                 child_base_index,
192:                 mut child_mask,
193:             } => {
194:                 let bit = depth - 1;
195:                 let octant_x = (x >> bit) & 1;
196:                 let octant_y = (y >> bit) & 1;
197:                 let octant_z = (z >> bit) & 1;
198:                 let octant_idx = (octant_z << 2) | (octant_y << 1) | octant_x;
199: 
200:                 let child_node_idx = child_base_index as usize + octant_idx as usize;
201: 
202:                 if v_type != 0 {
203:                     child_mask |= 1 << octant_idx;
204:                 }
205: 
206:                 self.nodes[node_idx] = SvoNode::Internal {
207:                     child_base_index,
208:                     child_mask,
209:                 };
210: 
211:                 let mask = (1 << bit) - 1;
212:                 self.set_recursive(
213:                     child_node_idx,
214:                     x & mask,
215:                     y & mask,
216:                     z & mask,
217:                     depth - 1,
218:                     v_type,
219:                     col,
220:                     ll,
221:                     fo,
222:                 );
223: 
224:                 // Try to collapse
225:                 self.collapse_if_uniform(node_idx);
226:             }
227:         }
228:     }
229: 
230:     fn collapse_if_uniform(&mut self, node_idx: usize) {
231:         if let SvoNode::Internal {
232:             child_base_index, ..
233:         } = self.nodes[node_idx]
234:         {
235:             let first_child_idx = child_base_index as usize;
236:             let mut uniform = true;
237:             let mut first_val = None;
238: 
239:             for i in 0..8 {
240:                 match self.nodes[first_child_idx + i] {
241:                     SvoNode::Internal { .. } => {
242:                         uniform = false;
243:                         break;
244:                     }
245:                     SvoNode::Leaf {
246:                         voxel_type,
247:                         color,
248:                         light_rgb,
249:                         face_occlusion,
250:                     } => {
251:                         if let Some((vt, col, ll, fo)) = first_val {
252:                             if vt != voxel_type
253:                                 || col != color
254:                                 || ll != light_rgb
255:                                 || fo != face_occlusion
256:                             {
257:                                 uniform = false;
258:                                 break;
259:                             }
260:                         } else {
261:                             first_val = Some((voxel_type, color, light_rgb, face_occlusion));
262:                         }
263:                     }
264:                 }
265:             }
266: 
267:             if uniform {
268:                 if let Some((vt, col, ll, fo)) = first_val {
269:                     self.nodes[node_idx] = SvoNode::Leaf {
270:                         voxel_type: vt,
271:                         color: col,
272:                         light_rgb: ll,
273:                         face_occlusion: fo,
274:                     };
275:                 }
276:             }
277:         }
278:     }
279: }

  1: //! The endless unplanned office fabric: an irregular warren of yellow rooms
  2: //! on a hidden lattice, chained through hashed doorways (binary-tree rule
  3: //! guarantees global connectivity chunk-locally) and merged by
  4: //! porosity-driven wall dropout so no grid is ever readable. Open expanses
  5: //! and vaults punctuate it; they are never the default.
  6: 
  7: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::RealitySnapshot;
  8: use crate::entities::models::Position;
  9: use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_FLOOR, VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_WALL};
 10: use crate::use_cases::generate_chunk::LevelTuning;
 11: use crate::use_cases::ports::NoiseProvider;
 12: use crate::use_cases::region_plan::PLAN_WALL_T;
 13: 
 14: use super::{BackroomsLevel, ColumnPlan, DOOR_HEIGHT, DOOR_WIDTH};
 15: 
 16: /// The default fabric room lattice. Rooms are chained through hashed
 17: /// doorways and merged by wall dropout, so the cell size never reads as a
 18: /// grid from inside — it is the scale of the labyrinth, not its shape.
 19: pub(super) const FABRIC_CELL: f32 = 7.2;
 20: 
 21: /// Column grid spacing inside expanses.
 22: const EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD: f32 = 7.2;
 23: 
 24: /// Ceiling light panel spacing. The coffer beam grid shares this period,
 25: /// but beams are a renderer shading pattern, never stepped ceiling geometry.
 26: pub(super) const LIGHT_PERIOD: f32 = 2.8;
 27: 
 28: /// The broad ceiling hierarchy that gives Level 0 scale without turning the
 29: /// whole map into a warehouse. It is local implementation detail rather than
 30: /// a world semantic: assemblies and corridors may override it.
 31: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 32: pub(super) enum FabricCeilingBand {
 33:     Compression,
 34:     Regular,
 35:     Expanse,
 36:     Vault,
 37: }
 38: 
 39: impl BackroomsLevel {
 40:     /// Smooth world-space noise in [-1, 1]. `scale` stretches the provider's
 41:     /// built-in ~20 u wavelength: wavelength = 20 / scale.
 42:     pub(super) fn n(noise: &dyn NoiseProvider, seed: u32, salt: u32, x: f32, z: f32, scale: f32) -> f32 {
 43:         noise.evaluate_2d(seed ^ salt, Position::new(x * scale, z * scale))
 44:     }
 45: 
 46:     /// Decorrelated per-cell hash in [0, 1): samples the value noise exactly
 47:     /// on its lattice (provider frequency is 0.05, so inputs that are
 48:     /// multiples of 20 hit lattice points), where it is uniform rather than
 49:     /// interpolation-smoothed toward zero.
 50:     pub(super) fn cell_hash(noise: &dyn NoiseProvider, seed: u32, salt: u32, cx: i64, cz: i64) -> f32 {
 51:         let v = noise.evaluate_2d(
 52:             seed ^ salt,
 53:             Position::new(cx as f32 * 20.0, cz as f32 * 20.0),
 54:         );
 55:         (v * 0.5 + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 0.999)
 56:     }
 57: 
 58:     /// Broad, low-frequency ceiling territory. The thresholds are chosen to
 59:     /// bias the sampled world toward regular dropped ceilings while retaining
 60:     /// meaningful regions of open volume and rare compression.
 61:     pub(super) fn fabric_ceiling_band(
 62:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 63:         seed: u32,
 64:         wx: f32,
 65:         wz: f32,
 66:     ) -> FabricCeilingBand {
 67:         // Regular dropped ceiling — the labyrinth fabric — is the default
 68:         // condition of Level 0. Expanses and vaults are deliberate
 69:         // punctuation the maze occasionally opens into, never the baseline.
 70:         let field = Self::n(noise, seed, 0xAA10, wx, wz, 0.18);
 71:         if field < -0.60 {
 72:             FabricCeilingBand::Compression
 73:         } else if field < 0.52 {
 74:             FabricCeilingBand::Regular
 75:         } else if field < 0.76 {
 76:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse
 77:         } else {
 78:             FabricCeilingBand::Vault
 79:         }
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     /// Ceiling heights are architectural tiers, not terrain. The common
 83:     /// bands are perfectly flat; open volumes vary per ~8 u ceiling *zone*
 84:     /// (one suspended-grid bay run), never per column, and every height
 85:     /// snaps to the fine voxel lattice so voxelization cannot add
 86:     /// sub-voxel stair-stepping on top.
 87:     pub(super) fn fabric_ceiling_height(
 88:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 89:         seed: u32,
 90:         wx: f32,
 91:         wz: f32,
 92:         band: FabricCeilingBand,
 93:     ) -> f32 {
 94:         const ZONE: f32 = 8.0;
 95:         let zone_x = (wx / ZONE).floor() * ZONE + ZONE * 0.5;
 96:         let zone_z = (wz / ZONE).floor() * ZONE + ZONE * 0.5;
 97:         let detail = Self::n(noise, seed, 0xB300, zone_x, zone_z, 0.72);
 98:         let (height, lo, hi) = match band {
 99:             FabricCeilingBand::Compression => (2.6, 2.5, 2.8),
100:             FabricCeilingBand::Regular => (3.4, 3.2, 3.6),
101:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse => (4.1 + 0.3 * detail, 3.8, 4.4),
102:             FabricCeilingBand::Vault => (4.95 + 0.45 * detail, 4.5, 5.4),
103:         };
104:         // Snap to the fine voxel lattice, then clamp last: 21 * 0.2 is
105:         // 4.2000003 in f32 and must not escape the band's range.
106:         ((height / 0.2).round() * 0.2).clamp(lo, hi)
107:     }
108: 
109:     /// Is (wx, wz) inside an open expanse of the fabric?
110:     pub(super) fn in_expanse(noise: &dyn NoiseProvider, seed: u32, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> bool {
111:         matches!(
112:             Self::fabric_ceiling_band(noise, seed, wx, wz),
113:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse | FabricCeilingBand::Vault
114:         )
115:     }
116: 
117:     /// The fabric plan as it was first observed — Peripheral Shift epoch 0
118:     /// everywhere. Kept for callers that deliberately freeze the fabric.
119:     #[cfg(test)]
120:     pub(crate) fn column_plan(
121:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
122:         seed: u32,
123:         tuning: &LevelTuning,
124:         wx: f32,
125:         wz: f32,
126:     ) -> ColumnPlan {
127:         Self::column_plan_in_reality(noise, seed, tuning, &RealitySnapshot::empty(), wx, wz)
128:     }
129: 
130:     /// The *fabric* column plan at world position (wx, wz): the endless,
131:     /// unplanned office fill between planned corridors and assemblies.
132:     ///
133:     /// This is where the wiki's Peripheral Shift lives: `reality` carries a
134:     /// drift epoch per 40 u cell, advanced by the engine whenever territory
135:     /// goes unobserved. The epoch re-salts only the *cosmetic and porosity*
136:     /// decisions — wall dropout, doorway direction/position/width framing,
137:     /// dead lights — while the ceiling territories, porosity climate,
138:     /// junction posts, and expanse structure stay fixed, so a returning
139:     /// wanderer recognizes the neighborhood but never the hallways. Every
140:     /// decision reads its epoch at the deciding lattice cell's own anchor,
141:     /// so a wall is rebuilt whole even when a drift-cell boundary crosses it,
142:     /// and the binary-tree doorway rule holds per cell at any epoch mix —
143:     /// the labyrinth stays globally connected through every rearrangement.
144:     pub(crate) fn column_plan_in_reality(
145:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
146:         seed: u32,
147:         tuning: &LevelTuning,
148:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
149:         wx: f32,
150:         wz: f32,
151:     ) -> ColumnPlan {
152:         // ---- ceiling field -------------------------------------------------
153:         let ceiling_band = Self::fabric_ceiling_band(noise, seed, wx, wz);
154:         let ceiling_units = Self::fabric_ceiling_height(noise, seed, wx, wz, ceiling_band);
155: 
156:         // In open and vaulted regions, partitions dissolve and only sparse
157:         // structural columns remain. The cheap dropped-ceiling material is
158:         // therefore carried through unexpectedly large space.
159:         let expanse = matches!(
160:             ceiling_band,
161:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse | FabricCeilingBand::Vault
162:         );
163: 
164:         // Coffer beams are shading detail in the renderer, not geometry: a
165:         // 0.2 u drop at a 0.2 u voxel scale turned every beam into a
166:         // full-voxel step and read as noisy terrain overhead. The splat
167:         // shader darkens the same COFFER_PERIOD grid instead.
168: 
169:         // ---- solids ------------------------------------------------------
170:         let mut solid = false;
171:         let mut lintel_from_units: Option<f32> = None;
172: 
173:         if expanse {
174:             // Sparse structural columns hold the expanse ceiling up.
175:             let cx = (wx / EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
176:             let cz = (wz / EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
177:             let on_site = wx.rem_euclid(EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD) < 0.45
178:                 && wz.rem_euclid(EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD) < 0.45;
179:             if on_site && Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, 0xF200, cx, cz) < 0.7 * tuning.pillars {
180:                 solid = true;
181:             }
182:         } else {
183:             // The default fabric *is* the Backrooms labyrinth: an irregular
184:             // warren of yellow rooms chained through hashed doorways.
185:             // Connectivity is a binary-tree rule — every cell knocks a
186:             // doorway through its west *or* its north wall — so all rooms
187:             // connect without a chunk ever seeing its neighbors. Smoothly
188:             // drifting porosity (whole walls dropped, wider thresholds,
189:             // second doorways) breaks the lattice read: it plays as one
190:             // endless wrong building, never as "a maze section".
191:             let t = PLAN_WALL_T;
192:             let fx = wx.rem_euclid(FABRIC_CELL);
193:             let fz = wz.rem_euclid(FABRIC_CELL);
194:             let (in_w, in_n) = (fx < t, fz < t);
195:             if in_w && in_n {
196:                 // Junction posts anchor every corner; where the walls
197:                 // around them have dropped they survive as column stubs.
198:                 solid = tuning.walls > 0.0;
199:             } else if in_w || in_n {
200:                 let cx = (wx / FABRIC_CELL).floor() as i64;
201:                 let cz = (wz / FABRIC_CELL).floor() as i64;
202:                 // The whole fabric cell rearranges as one: its epoch is read
203:                 // at the cell's own center, never at the sampled column.
204:                 let epoch = reality.fabric_drift_epoch(
205:                     (cx as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_CELL,
206:                     (cz as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_CELL,
207:                 );
208:                 let drift = |salt: u32| salt ^ epoch.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9);
209:                 // Strain is the price of poor provisioning: the delirium
210:                 // tier folds into a decision's salt only when it is nonzero,
211:                 // so a well-managed wanderer's world is byte-identical to
212:                 // the tierless one.
213:                 let tier = reality.delirium() as u32;
214:                 let strain = |salt: u32| drift(salt) ^ tier.wrapping_mul(0x85EB_CA6B);
215:                 // 0 = tight labyrinth, 1 = broken-open suites; drifts over
216:                 // ~180 u so density changes read as neighborhoods, not zones.
217:                 // The porosity climate is character, not layout: it survives
218:                 // every Peripheral Shift, so a broken-open neighborhood
219:                 // rearranges into another broken-open neighborhood.
220:                 let porosity =
221:                     (Self::n(noise, seed, 0x9010, wx, wz, 0.11) * 0.5 + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
222:                 let opens_west = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, drift(0x9200), cx, cz) < 0.5;
223:                 let (wall_salt, door_salt, opens_here) = if in_w {
224:                     (drift(0x9300u32), drift(0x9500u32), opens_west)
225:                 } else {
226:                     (drift(0x9400u32), drift(0x9600u32), !opens_west)
227:                 };
228:                 // Under strain the binary-tree guarantee itself erodes: a
229:                 // cell's guaranteed doorway can be found bricked over, and
230:                 // the warren grows dead-end pockets in proportion to how
231:                 // badly the wanderer has managed their provisions. Tier 0
232:                 // never seals, so a provisioned world stays fully connected.
233:                 let sealed = tier > 0
234:                     && Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, strain(0x9800), cx, cz)
235:                         < 0.10 * tier as f32;
236:                 let opens_here = opens_here && !sealed;
237:                 // Whole-wall dropout merges rooms into larger wrong shapes.
238:                 // Porosity varies along a run, so drops end ragged rather
239:                 // than on clean cell boundaries. The walls knob scales
240:                 // survival: 0 empties the fabric, 2 approaches a full grid.
241:                 //
242:                 // A Peripheral Shift is not a reshuffle of the same maze: an
243:                 // epoch-salted neighborhood field biases wall survival ±0.16
244:                 // (smooth like porosity, zero at epoch 0), so a returning
245:                 // wanderer finds warren where they remember openness and
246:                 // openness where they remember warren — a different tree of
247:                 // a map, still inside the porosity climate's character.
248:                 let shift_bias = if epoch == 0 {
249:                     0.0
250:                 } else {
251:                     0.16 * Self::n(noise, seed, drift(0x9700), wx, wz, 0.07)
252:                 };
253:                 let survive =
254:                     (0.92 - 0.42 * porosity + shift_bias) * tuning.walls.clamp(0.0, 1.5);
255:                 if Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, wall_salt, cx, cz) < survive {
256:                     let along = if in_w { fz } else { fx };
257:                     // The binary-tree wall usually gets its doorway; porous
258:                     // neighborhoods often cut a second one. Strain thins the
259:                     // second doorways by lowering the same threshold, so
260:                     // rising tiers close alternative routes rather than
261:                     // re-dealing them.
262:                     let extra = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, door_salt ^ 0x1F, cx, cz)
263:                         < (0.18 + 0.42 * porosity) * (1.0 - 0.22 * tier as f32);
264:                     if opens_here || extra {
265:                         let dh = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, door_salt, cx, cz);
266:                         let width = DOOR_WIDTH + 0.2 + 2.2 * porosity;
267:                         let pos = t + (FABRIC_CELL - 2.0 * t - width) * dh;
268:                         if along >= pos && along < pos + width {
269:                             // Narrow thresholds sometimes keep a lintel:
270:                             // framed evidence of doors that once existed.
271:                             if width < 2.0
272:                                 && Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, door_salt ^ 0x2E, cx, cz) < 0.35
273:                             {
274:                                 lintel_from_units = Some(DOOR_HEIGHT);
275:                             }
276:                         } else {
277:                             solid = true;
278:                         }
279:                     } else if tier >= 2
280:                         && Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, strain(0x9900), cx, cz)
281:                             < 0.06 * (tier - 1) as f32
282:                     {
283:                         // A deep-strain wall occasionally hides a slip: a
284:                         // 0.8 u lintel-framed slot barely wider than a
285:                         // wanderer, in a wall that offers no doorway at all.
286:                         // The punished labyrinth grows secrets alongside its
287:                         // dead ends — but only for those desperate enough to
288:                         // brush every wall.
289:                         let sh = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, strain(0x9A00), cx, cz);
290:                         let width = 0.8;
291:                         let pos = t + (FABRIC_CELL - 2.0 * t - width) * sh;
292:                         if along >= pos && along < pos + width {
293:                             lintel_from_units = Some(DOOR_HEIGHT);
294:                         } else {
295:                             solid = true;
296:                         }
297:                     } else {
298:                         solid = true;
299:                     }
300:                 }
301:             }
302:         }
303: 
304:         // ---- lights ------------------------------------------------------
305:         let light = if !solid {
306:             // Open regions keep a longer, sparser fluorescent rhythm; the
307:             // regular dropped ceiling retains the denser office grid.
308:             let panel_period = if expanse { 4.8 } else { LIGHT_PERIOD };
309:             let lx = (wx - panel_period * 0.5).rem_euclid(panel_period);
310:             let lz = (wz - panel_period * 0.5).rem_euclid(panel_period);
311:             let cell_x = (wx / panel_period).floor() as i64;
312:             let cell_z = (wz / panel_period).floor() as i64;
313:             let anchor_x = (cell_x as f32 + 0.5) * panel_period;
314:             let anchor_z = (cell_z as f32 + 0.5) * panel_period;
315:             // Old territory keeps fewer of its tubes alive: institution age
316:             // scales the survival ratio from ~1.15x (new wings feel almost
317:             // maintained) down to ~0.6x (ancient wings run on remnants).
318:             // Sampled at the panel's own anchor so one fixture never splits
319:             // into half-lit columns.
320:             let age = crate::use_cases::world_topology::institution_age_at(
321:                 noise, seed, anchor_x, anchor_z,
322:             );
323:             let keep = if expanse { 0.66 } else { 0.78 } * tuning.lights * (1.15 - 0.55 * age);
324:             // Which panels burned out is cosmetic memory, so the Peripheral
325:             // Shift re-deals it: the light that guided you out may be dead
326:             // when you walk back in.
327:             let epoch = reality.fabric_drift_epoch(anchor_x, anchor_z);
328:             let salt = 0xE900 ^ epoch.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9);
329:             let alive = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, salt, cell_x, cell_z) < keep;
330:             lx < 0.45 && lz < 0.45 && alive
331:         } else {
332:             false
333:         };
334: 
335:         ColumnPlan {
336:             floor: true,
337:             floor_units: 0.0,
338:             solid,
339:             ceiling_units,
340:             light,
341:             red_light: false,
342:             lintel_from_units,
343:             wall_material: VOXEL_WALL,
344:             floor_material: VOXEL_FLOOR,
345:             light_material: VOXEL_LIGHT,
346:         }
347:     }
348: }
````

 31: /// Flyweight Room Stamps

 38: 
 39: impl RoomStamp {
 40:     fn cubicles() -> Self {
 41:         let width = 20;
 42:         let depth = 20;
 43:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 44:         for z in 2..8 {
 45:             data[z * width + 5] = 1;
 46:         }
 47:         for x in 2..8 {
 48:             data[5 * width + x] = 1;
 49:         }
 50:         for z in 12..18 {
 51:             data[z * width + 15] = 1;
 52:         }
 53:         for x in 12..18 {
 54:             data[15 * width + x] = 1;
 55:         }
 56:         Self { width, depth, data }
 57:     }
 58: 
 59:     fn showroom() -> Self {
 60:         let width = 16;
 61:         let depth = 16;
 62:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 63:         for z in 2..6 {
 64:             for x in 2..6 {
 65:                 data[z * width + x] = 2;
 66:             }
 67:             for x in 10..14 {
 68:                 data[z * width + x] = 2;
 69:             }
 70:         }
 71:         for z in 10..14 {
 72:             for x in 2..6 {
 73:                 data[z * width + x] = 2;
 74:             }
 75:             for x in 10..14 {
 76:                 data[z * width + x] = 2;
 77:             }
 78:         }
 79:         Self { width, depth, data }
 80:     }

 82:     fn waiting() -> Self {
 83:         let width = 20;
 84:         let depth = 20;
 85:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];

 89:         }

 93:     fn storage() -> Self {
 94:         let width = 12;
 95:         let depth = 16;
 96:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 97:         for z in 2..14 {
 98:             data[z * width + 2] = 1;
 99:             data[z * width + 9] = 1;
100:         }
101:         Self { width, depth, data }
102:     }
103: 
104:     fn lounge() -> Self {
105:         let width = 18;
106:         let depth = 18;
107:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
108:         for z in 6..12 {
109:             for x in 6..12 {
110:                 if z == 6 || z == 11 || x == 6 || x == 11 {
111:                     data[z * width + x] = 3;
112:                 }
113:             }
114:         }
115:         Self { width, depth, data }
116:     }
117: 
118:     fn server_room() -> Self {
119:         let width = 14;
120:         let depth = 20;
121:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
122:         for x in [3, 7, 10].iter() {
123:             for z in 2..18 {
124:                 if z % 4 != 0 {
125:                     data[z * width + x] = 2;
126:                 }
127:             }
128:         }
129:         Self { width, depth, data }
130:     }
131: 
132:     fn cafeteria() -> Self {
133:         let width = 24;
134:         let depth = 24;
135:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
136:         for z in [4, 10, 16, 20].iter() {
137:             for x in [4, 10, 16, 20].iter() {
138:                 data[z * width + x] = 1;
139:                 data[*z * width + x + 1] = 1;
140:                 data[(z + 1) * width + x] = 1;
141:                 data[(z + 1) * width + x + 1] = 1;
142:             }
143:         }
144:         Self { width, depth, data }
145:     }
146: 
147:     fn maintenance() -> Self {
148:         let width = 10;
149:         let depth = 10;
150:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
151:         data[2 * width + 2] = 2;
152:         data[2 * width + 7] = 2;
153:         data[7 * width + 2] = 2;
154:         data[7 * width + 7] = 2;
155:         data[4 * width + 4] = 3;
156:         data[4 * width + 5] = 3;
157:         data[5 * width + 4] = 3;
158:         data[5 * width + 5] = 3;
159:         Self { width, depth, data }
160:     }
161: 
162:     fn stairway() -> Self {
163:         let width = 16;
164:         let depth = 16;
165:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
166:         for z in 0..16 {
167:             for x in 0..16 {
168:                 if x > 9 {
169:                     data[z * width + x] = 4; // raised
170:                 } else if x == 9 {
171:                     data[z * width + x] = 5; // step 2
172:                 } else if x == 8 {
173:                     data[z * width + x] = 6; // step 1
174:                 }
175:             }
176:         }
177:         Self { width, depth, data }
178:     }
179: }
180: 
181: /// Generates one legacy blueprint chunk. Pure in `(chunk_pos, seed, config)`
182: /// given a deterministic noise provider; telemetry is observation only.
183: pub(crate) fn generate_legacy_blueprint(
184:     noise_provider: &dyn NoiseProvider,
185:     telemetry: &dyn TelemetryPort,
186:     chunk_pos: Position,
187:     seed: u32,
188:     config: GeneratorConfig,
189: ) -> VoxelGrid {
190:     let start_micros = telemetry.now_micros();
191: 
192:     let width = (config.chunk_size / config.voxel_scale).round() as usize;
193:     let depth = (config.chunk_size / config.voxel_scale).round() as usize;
194: 
195:     // Cell voxel borders derive from world space (cells are 5.0 units) so
196:     // every LOD of a chunk puts its walls on the same world planes.
197:     // Truncating a fixed voxels-per-cell instead compresses the maze at
198:     // scales where 5.0/voxel_scale is fractional.
199:     let cell_border = |c: usize| (c as f32 * 5.0 / config.voxel_scale).round() as usize;
200:     let cell_w = ((config.chunk_size / 5.0).round() as usize).max(1);
201:     let cell_d = cell_w;
202: 
203:     let mut abstract_grid = Grid::new(cell_w, cell_d);
204: 
205:     // --- ZONE ASSIGNMENT PASS ---
206:     let mut max_chunk_height_units = 3.0_f32;
207:     for cz in 0..cell_d {
208:         for cx in 0..cell_w {
209:             let wx = chunk_pos.x * config.chunk_size + (cx as f32) * 5.0;
210:             let wz = chunk_pos.z * config.chunk_size + (cz as f32) * 5.0;
211: 
212:             // Low frequency noise for zone clustering
213:             let n = noise_provider.evaluate_2d(
214:                 seed ^ 0x2b8f_a43c,
215:                 crate::entities::models::Position::new(wx * 0.05, wz * 0.05),
216:             ); // n is in [-1, 1]
217: 
218:             use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
219:             let mut zone = MicrobiomeZone::Standard;
220: 
221:             if n < -0.7 {
222:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::Blackout;
223:             } else if n < -0.4 {
224:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::Holes;
225:             } else if n > 0.85 - (config.tuning.atria as f32 * 0.1) {
226:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::Atrium;
227:             } else if n > 0.6 {
228:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::PillarField;
229:             } else if n > 0.4 {
230:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::Arch;
231:             } else if n > 0.2 && n < 0.25 {
232:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom;
233:             }
234: 
235:             if let Some(cell) = abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, cz) {
236:                 cell.zone = zone;
237:             }
238: 
239:             let cell_h = match zone {
240:                 MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,  // 4.0 * 3.0x
241:                 MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2, // 4.0 * 0.8x
242:                 _ => 4.0,
243:             };
244:             if cell_h > max_chunk_height_units {
245:                 max_chunk_height_units = cell_h;
246:             }
247:         }
248:     }
249: 
250:     let height = (max_chunk_height_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize + 2; // +2 for floor and ceiling bounds
251: 
252:     telemetry.log(&format!(
253:             "[INFO] Entering GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::execute. Args: chunk_pos={:?}, seed={}, chunk_size={} (Voxel dimensions: {}x{}x{})",
254:             chunk_pos, seed, config.chunk_size, width, height, depth
255:         ));
256: 
257:     let mut grid = VoxelGrid::new(width, height, depth);
258: 
259:     // STARTING HUB OVERRIDE: Chunk (0,0) is a massive open plaza that feeds seamlessly into the maze
260:     if chunk_pos.x.abs() < 1.0 && chunk_pos.z.abs() < 1.0 {
261:         for z in 0..depth {
262:             for x in 0..width {
263:                 grid.set(x, 0, z, VOXEL_FLOOR);
264:                 grid.set(x, height - 1, z, VOXEL_CEILING);
265: 
266:                 // Scatter ceiling panels without replacing walkable floor material.
267:                 if x > 0 && z > 0 && x % 20 == 0 && z % 20 == 0 {
268:                     grid.set(x, height - 1, z, VOXEL_LIGHT);
269:                 }
270:             }
271:         }
272:         let lighting =
273:             crate::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::VoxelLightingSettings::with_default_range(
274:                 config.voxel_scale,
275:             )
276:             .expect("GeneratorConfig voxel_scale must be finite and greater than zero");
277:         crate::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::bake_voxel_lighting(&mut grid, lighting);
278:         return grid;
279:     }
280: 
281:     // ==========================================
282:     // DYNAMIC GENERATION (Growing Tree & BSP)
283:     // ==========================================
284:     let mut rng = StdRng::seed_from_u64(
285:         (seed as u64) ^ (chunk_pos.x.to_bits() as u64) ^ (chunk_pos.z.to_bits() as u64),
286:     );
287:     // Per-voxel cosmetic noise (floor holes, dotted pillars) draws from
288:     // its own stream: the number of those draws depends on voxel
289:     // resolution, and letting them share the structural RNG would
290:     // desynchronize wall/door placement between LODs of the same chunk.
291:     let mut detail_rng = StdRng::seed_from_u64(
292:         (seed as u64)
293:             ^ (chunk_pos.x.to_bits() as u64)
294:             ^ (chunk_pos.z.to_bits() as u64)
295:             ^ 0xD57A_11ED,
296:     );
297: 
298:     let maze_gen = GrowingTreeGenerator {
299:         junction_density: config.tuning.junction_density,
300:     };
301:     maze_gen.generate(&mut abstract_grid, &mut rng);
302: 
303:     // Organic room segmentation
304:     let mut rooms = Vec::new();
305:     let mut room_grid = vec![None; cell_w * cell_d];
306: 
307:     // Tunable parameters
308:     let num_room_attempts = 15;
309:     for _ in 0..num_room_attempts {
310:         let cx = rng.random_range(0..cell_w);
311:         let cz = rng.random_range(0..cell_d);
312:         let rw = rng.random_range(1..=3);
313:         let rd = rng.random_range(1..=3);
314: 
315:         if cx + rw <= cell_w && cz + rd <= cell_d {
316:             let mut overlap = false;
317:             for i in 0..rw {
318:                 for j in 0..rd {
319:                     if room_grid[(cz + j) * cell_w + cx + i].is_some() {
320:                         overlap = true;
321:                     }
322:                 }
323:             }
324:             if !overlap {
325:                 let room_id = rooms.len();
326:                 for i in 0..rw {
327:                     for j in 0..rd {
328:                         room_grid[(cz + j) * cell_w + cx + i] = Some(room_id);
329:                         if let Some(cell) = abstract_grid.get_mut(cx + i, cz + j) {
330:                             if j > 0 {
331:                                 cell.walls[0] = false;
332:                             }
333:                             if i < rw - 1 {
334:                                 cell.walls[1] = false;
335:                             }
336:                             if j < rd - 1 {
337:                                 cell.walls[2] = false;
338:                             }
339:                             if i > 0 {
340:                                 cell.walls[3] = false;
341:                             }
342:                         }
343:                     }
344:                 }
345:                 rooms.push(Room {
346:                     name: "Organic",
347:                     x0: cell_border(cx),
348:                     x1: cell_border(cx + rw) - 1,
349:                     z0: cell_border(cz),
350:                     z1: cell_border(cz + rd) - 1,
351:                 });
352:             }
353:         }
354:     }
355: 
356:     // Hallway reservation (Part 1)
357:     let mut non_room_indices = Vec::new();
358:     for i in 0..(cell_w * cell_d) {
359:         if room_grid[i].is_none() {
360:             non_room_indices.push(i);
361:         }
362:     }
363: 
364:     let target_corridors = (non_room_indices.len() as f32 * 0.20) as usize;
365:     let mut corridor_count = 0;
366: 
367:     use rand::seq::SliceRandom;
368:     non_room_indices.shuffle(&mut rng);
369: 
370:     for &idx in &non_room_indices {
371:         if corridor_count >= target_corridors {
372:             break;
373:         }
374:         let cx = idx % cell_w;
375:         let cz = idx / cell_w;
376:         if abstract_grid.get(cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor {
377:             continue;
378:         }
379: 
380:         abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
381:         corridor_count += 1;
382: 
383:         // Extend North
384:         let mut current_cz = cz;
385:         while current_cz > 0 && !abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().walls[0] {
386:             current_cz -= 1;
387:             if room_grid[current_cz * cell_w + cx].is_some()
388:                 || abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor
389:             {
390:                 break;
391:             }
392:             abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
393:             corridor_count += 1;
394:         }
395:         // Extend South
396:         let mut current_cz = cz;
397:         while current_cz < cell_d - 1 && !abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().walls[2] {
398:             current_cz += 1;
399:             if room_grid[current_cz * cell_w + cx].is_some()
400:                 || abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor
401:             {
402:                 break;
403:             }
404:             abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
405:             corridor_count += 1;
406:         }
407:         // Extend West
408:         let mut current_cx = cx;
409:         while current_cx > 0 && !abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().walls[3] {
410:             current_cx -= 1;
411:             if room_grid[cz * cell_w + current_cx].is_some()
412:                 || abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor
413:             {
414:                 break;
415:             }
416:             abstract_grid.get_mut(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
417:             corridor_count += 1;
418:         }
419:         // Extend East
420:         let mut current_cx = cx;
421:         while current_cx < cell_w - 1 && !abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().walls[1] {
422:             current_cx += 1;
423:             if room_grid[cz * cell_w + current_cx].is_some()
424:                 || abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor
425:             {
426:                 break;
427:             }
428:             abstract_grid.get_mut(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
429:             corridor_count += 1;
430:         }
431:     }
432: 
433:     // Draw abstract grid to VoxelGrid
434:     for cz in 0..cell_d {
435:         for cx in 0..cell_w {
436:             let cell = abstract_grid.get(cx, cz).unwrap();
437:             let v_x0 = cell_border(cx);
438:             let v_z0 = cell_border(cz);
439:             let v_x1 = (cell_border(cx + 1) - 1).min(width - 1);
440:             let v_z1 = (cell_border(cz + 1) - 1).min(depth - 1);
441: 
442:             use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
443:             let cell_h_units = match cell.zone {
444:                 MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,
445:                 MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2,
446:                 _ => 4.0,
447:             };
448:             let wall_max_y = (cell_h_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
449:             let door_max_y = (2.5 / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize; // Doorways are 2.5 units tall
450: 
451:             let wall_type = VOXEL_WALL;
452: 
453:             // Floors and Ceilings
454:             for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
455:                 for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
456:                     grid.set(vx, 0, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
457: 
458:                     if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Holes {
459:                         if vx > v_x0 + 5 && vx < v_x1 - 5 && vz > v_z0 + 5 && vz < v_z1 - 5 {
460:                             if detail_rng.random_bool(0.05) {
461:                                 grid.set(vx, 0, vz, VOXEL_AIR);
462:                             }
463:                         }
464:                     }
465: 
466:                     if cell.zone != MicrobiomeZone::Atrium {
467:                         // Normal ceilings with hanging light
468:                         grid.set(vx, wall_max_y, vz, VOXEL_CEILING); // Always close the ceiling
469:                         if cell.zone != MicrobiomeZone::Blackout && (vx % 10 == 0 && vz % 10 == 0) {
470:                             if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom {
471:                                 grid.set(
472:                                     vx,
473:                                     wall_max_y - 1,
474:                                     vz,
475:                                     crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VOXEL_RED_LIGHT,
476:                                 );
477:                             } else {
478:                                 grid.set(vx, wall_max_y - 1, vz, VOXEL_LIGHT);
479:                             }
480:                         }
481:                         for y in (wall_max_y + 1)..height {
482:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_CEILING);
483:                         }
484:                     } else {
485:                         // Atrium ceiling and bright hanging light
486:                         grid.set(vx, wall_max_y, vz, VOXEL_CEILING);
487:                         if vx % 10 == 0 && vz % 10 == 0 {
488:                             grid.set(vx, wall_max_y - 1, vz, VOXEL_LIGHT);
489:                         }
490:                     }
491:                 }
492:             }
493: 
494:             if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::PillarField {
495:                 for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
496:                     grid.set(v_x0, y, v_z0, wall_type);
497:                     grid.set(v_x1, y, v_z0, wall_type);
498:                     grid.set(v_x0, y, v_z1, wall_type);
499:                     grid.set(v_x1, y, v_z1, wall_type);
500:                     if detail_rng.random_bool(0.3) {
501:                         grid.set((v_x0 + v_x1 + 1) / 2, y, (v_z0 + v_z1 + 1) / 2, wall_type);
502:                     }
503:                 }
504:                 continue;
505:             }
506: 
507:             // South Wall (z1)
508:             if cz < cell_d - 1 {
509:                 let same_room = room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx] == room_grid[(cz + 1) * cell_w + cx]
510:                     && room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx].is_some();
511: 
512:                 if !same_room {
513:                     let width_choice = rng.random_range(0..100);
514:                     let hole_units = if width_choice < 15 {
515:                         1.2
516:                     } else if width_choice < 85 {
517:                         2.0
518:                     } else {
519:                         3.5
520:                     };
521:                     let hole_w = (hole_units / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
522:                     // Drawn in centimetres of the 5.0-unit cell span, not
523:                     // voxels, so every LOD picks the same door position.
524:                     let hole_cm = (hole_units * 100.0) as u32;
525:                     let max_offset_cm = 500u32.saturating_sub(hole_cm + 50);
526:                     let offset_cm = if max_offset_cm > 50 {
527:                         rng.random_range(50..max_offset_cm)
528:                     } else {
529:                         50
530:                     };
531:                     let offset = (offset_cm as f32 / 100.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
532:                     let hole_x0 = v_x0 + offset;
533:                     let hole_x1 = hole_x0 + hole_w;
534: 
535:                     for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
536:                         let in_hole = vx >= hole_x0 && vx < hole_x1;
537:                         if cell.walls[2] || !in_hole {
538:                             for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
539:                                 grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
540:                             }
541:                         } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
542:                             let dx = (vx as isize - (hole_x0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
543:                             let arch_top = door_max_y;
544:                             let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dx);
545:                             for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
546:                                 grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
547:                             }
548:                         } else {
549:                             for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
550:                                 grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
551:                             }
552:                         }
553:                     }
554:                 }
555:             } else if cz == cell_d - 1 {
556:                 // Chunk boundary (force holes for connectivity)
557:                 let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
558:                 let hole_x0 = (v_x0 + v_x1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
559:                 for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
560:                     let is_hole = vx >= hole_x0 && vx < hole_x0 + hole_w;
561:                     if !is_hole {
562:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
563:                             grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
564:                         }
565:                     } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
566:                         let dx = (vx as isize - (hole_x0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
567:                         let arch_top = door_max_y;
568:                         let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dx);
569:                         for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
570:                             grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
571:                         }
572:                     } else {
573:                         for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
574:                             grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
575:                         }
576:                     }
577:                 }
578:             }
579: 
580:             // East Wall (x1)
581:             if cx < cell_w - 1 {
582:                 let same_room = room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx] == room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx + 1]
583:                     && room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx].is_some();
584: 
585:                 if !same_room {
586:                     let width_choice = rng.random_range(0..100);
587:                     let hole_units = if width_choice < 15 {
588:                         1.2
589:                     } else if width_choice < 85 {
590:                         2.0
591:                     } else {
592:                         3.5
593:                     };
594:                     let hole_w = (hole_units / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
595:                     // Centimetre draw, same reasoning as the south wall.
596:                     let hole_cm = (hole_units * 100.0) as u32;
597:                     let max_offset_cm = 500u32.saturating_sub(hole_cm + 50);
598:                     let offset_cm = if max_offset_cm > 50 {
599:                         rng.random_range(50..max_offset_cm)
600:                     } else {
601:                         50
602:                     };
603:                     let offset = (offset_cm as f32 / 100.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
604:                     let hole_z0 = v_z0 + offset;
605:                     let hole_z1 = hole_z0 + hole_w;
606: 
607:                     for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
608:                         let in_hole = vz >= hole_z0 && vz < hole_z1;
609:                         if cell.walls[1] || !in_hole {
610:                             for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
611:                                 grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
612:                             }
613:                         } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
614:                             let dz = (vz as isize - (hole_z0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
615:                             let arch_top = door_max_y;
616:                             let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dz);
617:                             for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
618:                                 grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
619:                             }
620:                         } else {
621:                             for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
622:                                 grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
623:                             }
624:                         }
625:                     }
626:                 }
627:             } else if cx == cell_w - 1 {
628:                 let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
629:                 let hole_z0 = (v_z0 + v_z1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
630:                 for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
631:                     let is_hole = vz >= hole_z0 && vz < hole_z0 + hole_w;
632:                     if !is_hole {
633:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
634:                             grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
635:                         }
636:                     } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
637:                         let dz = (vz as isize - (hole_z0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
638:                         let arch_top = door_max_y;
639:                         let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dz);
640:                         for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
641:                             grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
642:                         }
643:                     } else {
644:                         for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
645:                             grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
646:                         }
647:                     }
648:                 }
649:             }
650: 
651:             // Draw narrower corridors for 2+ consecutive runs
652:             let mut is_ns_hall = false;
653:             let mut is_ew_hall = false;
654:             if cell.is_corridor {
655:                 let mut ns_run = 1;
656:                 if !cell.walls[0] && cz > 0 && abstract_grid.get(cx, cz - 1).unwrap().is_corridor {
657:                     ns_run += 1;
658:                 }
659:                 if !cell.walls[2]
660:                     && cz < cell_d - 1
661:                     && abstract_grid.get(cx, cz + 1).unwrap().is_corridor
662:                 {
663:                     ns_run += 1;
664:                 }
665: 
666:                 let mut ew_run = 1;
667:                 if !cell.walls[1]
668:                     && cx < cell_w - 1
669:                     && abstract_grid.get(cx + 1, cz).unwrap().is_corridor
670:                 {
671:                     ew_run += 1;
672:                 }
673:                 if !cell.walls[3] && cx > 0 && abstract_grid.get(cx - 1, cz).unwrap().is_corridor {
674:                     ew_run += 1;
675:                 }
676: 
677:                 if ns_run >= 2 {
678:                     is_ns_hall = true;
679:                 }
680:                 if ew_run >= 2 {
681:                     is_ew_hall = true;
682:                 }
683:             }
684: 
685:             if is_ns_hall && !is_ew_hall {
686:                 let inset_x = ((v_x1 - v_x0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
687:                 for vx in v_x0..=(v_x0 + inset_x) {
688:                     for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
689:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
690:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
691:                         }
692:                     }
693:                 }
694:                 for vx in (v_x1 - inset_x)..=v_x1 {
695:                     for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
696:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
697:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
698:                         }
699:                     }
700:                 }
701:             } else if is_ew_hall && !is_ns_hall {
702:                 let inset_z = ((v_z1 - v_z0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
703:                 for vz in v_z0..=(v_z0 + inset_z) {
704:                     for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
705:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
706:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
707:                         }
708:                     }
709:                 }
710:                 for vz in (v_z1 - inset_z)..=v_z1 {
711:                     for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
712:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
713:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
714:                         }
715:                     }
716:                 }
717:             } else if is_ns_hall && is_ew_hall {
718:                 let inset_x = ((v_x1 - v_x0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
719:                 let inset_z = ((v_z1 - v_z0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
720:                 for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
721:                     for vx in v_x0..=(v_x0 + inset_x) {
722:                         for vz in v_z0..=(v_z0 + inset_z) {
723:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
724:                         }
725:                     }
726:                     for vx in (v_x1 - inset_x)..=v_x1 {
727:                         for vz in v_z0..=(v_z0 + inset_z) {
728:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
729:                         }
730:                     }
731:                     for vx in v_x0..=(v_x0 + inset_x) {
732:                         for vz in (v_z1 - inset_z)..=v_z1 {
733:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
734:                         }
735:                     }
736:                     for vx in (v_x1 - inset_x)..=v_x1 {
737:                         for vz in (v_z1 - inset_z)..=v_z1 {
738:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
739:                         }
740:                     }
741:                 }
742:             }
743:         }
744:     }
745: 
746:     // Chunk Boundaries (North and West)
747:     for cz in 0..cell_d {
748:         let cell = abstract_grid.get(0, cz).unwrap();
749:         use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
750:         let cell_h_units = match cell.zone {
751:             MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,
752:             MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2,
753:             _ => 4.0,
754:         };
755:         let wall_max_y = (cell_h_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
756:         let door_max_y = (2.5 / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
757:         let wall_type = if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom {
758:             VOXEL_RED_WALL
759:         } else {
760:             VOXEL_WALL
761:         };
762: 
763:         if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::PillarField {
764:             continue;
765:         }
766: 
767:         let v_z0 = cell_border(cz);
768:         let v_z1 = (cell_border(cz + 1) - 1).min(depth - 1);
769:         let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
770:         let hole_z0 = (v_z0 + v_z1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
771:         for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
772:             let is_hole = vz >= hole_z0 && vz < hole_z0 + hole_w;
773:             if !is_hole {
774:                 for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
775:                     grid.set(0, y, vz, wall_type);
776:                 }
777:             } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
778:                 let dz = (vz as isize - (hole_z0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
779:                 let arch_top = door_max_y;
780:                 let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dz);
781:                 for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
782:                     grid.set(0, y, vz, wall_type);
783:                 }
784:             } else {
785:                 for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
786:                     grid.set(0, y, vz, wall_type);
787:                 }
788:             }
789:         }
790:     }
791:     for cx in 0..cell_w {
792:         let cell = abstract_grid.get(cx, 0).unwrap();
793:         use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
794:         let cell_h_units = match cell.zone {
795:             MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,
796:             MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2,
797:             _ => 4.0,
798:         };
799:         let wall_max_y = (cell_h_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
800:         let door_max_y = (2.5 / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
801:         let wall_type = if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom {
802:             VOXEL_RED_WALL
803:         } else {
804:             VOXEL_WALL
805:         };
806: 
807:         if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::PillarField {
808:             continue;
809:         }
810: 
811:         let v_x0 = cell_border(cx);
812:         let v_x1 = (cell_border(cx + 1) - 1).min(width - 1);
813:         let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
814:         let hole_x0 = (v_x0 + v_x1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
815:         for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
816:             let is_hole = vx >= hole_x0 && vx < hole_x0 + hole_w;
817:             if !is_hole {
818:                 for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
819:                     grid.set(vx, y, 0, wall_type);
820:                 }
821:             } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
822:                 let dx = (vx as isize - (hole_x0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
823:                 let arch_top = door_max_y;
824:                 let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dx);
825:                 for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
826:                     grid.set(vx, y, 0, wall_type);
827:                 }
828:             } else {
829:                 for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
830:                     grid.set(vx, y, 0, wall_type);
831:                 }
832:             }
833:         }
834:     }
835: 
836:     // Apply Room Stamps to generated rooms
837:     let stamps = vec![
838:         RoomStamp::cubicles(),
839:         RoomStamp::showroom(),
840:         RoomStamp::waiting(),
841:         RoomStamp::storage(),
842:         RoomStamp::lounge(),
843:         RoomStamp::server_room(),
844:         RoomStamp::cafeteria(),
845:         RoomStamp::maintenance(),
846:     ];
847: 
848:     for room in &rooms {
849:         let mut possible_stamps = Vec::new();
850:         for stamp in &stamps {
851:             let max_stamps_w = (room.x1 - room.x0) / stamp.width.max(1);
852:             let max_stamps_d = (room.z1 - room.z0) / stamp.depth.max(1);
853:             if max_stamps_w > 0 && max_stamps_d > 0 {
854:                 possible_stamps.push(stamp);
855:             }
856:         }
857:         // Both rolls happen whether or not a stamp fits: which stamps fit
858:         // depends on voxel resolution, and skipping draws would
859:         // desynchronize the structural RNG between LODs of the chunk.
860:         let stamp_roll = rng.random_range(0..usize::MAX);
861:         let stairs_roll = rng.random_bool(0.15 * (config.tuning.stairs_density as f64));
862:         if !possible_stamps.is_empty() {
863:             let mut stamp = possible_stamps[stamp_roll % possible_stamps.len()];
864: 
865:             // Low-frequency stairs chance override
866:             let stairway = RoomStamp::stairway();
867:             if stairs_roll {
868:                 stamp = &stairway;
869:             }
870: 
871:             let spacing = (6.0 * (config.voxel_scale / 0.1)) as usize;
872:             let mut start_x = room.x0 + spacing;
873:             while start_x + stamp.width <= room.x1.saturating_sub(spacing) {
874:                 let mut start_z = room.z0 + spacing;
875:                 while start_z + stamp.depth <= room.z1.saturating_sub(spacing) {
876:                     if validate_stamp_placement(&grid, room, stamp, start_x, start_z) {
877:                         place_stamp(&mut grid, stamp, start_x, start_z);
878:                     }
879:                     start_z += stamp.depth + spacing;
880:                 }
881:                 start_x += stamp.width + spacing;
882:             }
883:         }
884: 
885:         // Basic room lighting
886:         let cx = (room.x0 + room.x1) / 2;
887:         let is_strip = rng.random_bool(0.3); // 30% chance for strip lights
888:         let mut z = room.z0 + 8;
889: 
890:         while z <= room.z1.saturating_sub(8) {
891:             if is_strip {
892:                 for offset in 0..4 {
893:                     if z + offset <= room.z1 {
894:                         grid.set(cx, height - 1, z + offset, VOXEL_LIGHT);
895:                     }
896:                 }
897:             } else {
898:                 grid.set(cx, height - 1, z, VOXEL_LIGHT);
899:             }
900:             z += 12;
901:         }
902:     }
903: 
904:     // Basic corridor lighting
905:     for cz in (8..depth).step_by(16) {
906:         for cx in (8..width).step_by(16) {
907:             if grid.get(cx, height - 1, cz) == VOXEL_CEILING && grid.get(cx, 1, cz) == VOXEL_AIR {
908:                 grid.set(cx, height - 1, cz, VOXEL_LIGHT);
909:             }
910:         }
911:     }
912: 
913:     // ==========================================
914:     // PHYSICAL VOXEL LIGHTING BAKE
915:     // ==========================================
916:     let lighting =
917:         crate::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::VoxelLightingSettings::with_default_range(
918:             config.voxel_scale,
919:         )
920:         .expect("GeneratorConfig voxel_scale must be finite and greater than zero");
921:     crate::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::bake_voxel_lighting(&mut grid, lighting);
922: 
923:     let elapsed_micros = telemetry.now_micros().saturating_sub(start_micros);
924:     telemetry.log(&format!(
925:         "[TELEMETRY] execute completed. Duration={}us, OutputVoxelGridSize={}x{}x{}",
926:         elapsed_micros,
927:         grid.width(),
928:         grid.height(),
929:         grid.depth()
930:     ));
931: 
932:     grid
933: }
934: 
935: fn validate_stamp_placement(
936:     grid: &VoxelGrid,
937:     room: &Room,
938:     stamp: &RoomStamp,
939:     start_x: usize,
940:     start_z: usize,
941: ) -> bool {
942:     if start_x < room.x0
943:         || start_x + stamp.width > room.x1
944:         || start_z < room.z0
945:         || start_z + stamp.depth > room.z1
946:     {
947:         return false;
948:     }
949: 
950:     for lz in 0..stamp.depth {
951:         for lx in 0..stamp.width {
952:             let vx = start_x + lx;
953:             let vz = start_z + lz;
954:             if stamp.data[lz * stamp.width + lx] > 0 {
955:                 if grid.get(vx, 1, vz) != VOXEL_AIR && grid.get(vx, 1, vz) != VOXEL_FLOOR {
956:                     return false;
957:                 }
958:             }
959:         }
960:     }
961: 
962:     true
963: }
964: 
965: fn place_stamp(grid: &mut VoxelGrid, stamp: &RoomStamp, start_x: usize, start_z: usize) {
966:     let max_y = grid.height() - 2;
967:     for sz in 0..stamp.depth {
968:         for sx in 0..stamp.width {
969:             let val = stamp.data[sz * stamp.width + sx];
970:             let vx = start_x + sx;
971:             let vz = start_z + sz;
972:             if val == 1 {
973:                 for y in 1..=3 {
974:                     grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_WALL);
975:                 }
976:             } else if val == 2 {
977:                 for y in 1..=max_y {
978:                     grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_WALL);
979:                 }
980:             } else if val == 3 {
981:                 for y in 1..=1 {
982:                     grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_WALL);
983:                 }
984:             } else if val == 4 {
985:                 // Raised floor
986:                 grid.set(vx, 1, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
987:                 grid.set(vx, 2, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
988:             } else if val == 5 {
989:                 // Step 1
990:                 grid.set(vx, 1, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
991:             } else if val == 6 { // Step 2
992:                 // Just floor, already set
993:             }
994:         }
995:     }
996: }
````

## File: src/use_cases/level_generator.rs
