 442:     fn rng_next01(&mut self) -> f32 {
 443:         self.rng ^= self.rng << 13;
 444:         self.rng ^= self.rng >> 7;
 445:         self.rng ^= self.rng << 17;
 446:         (self.rng >> 40) as f32 / (1u64 << 24) as f32
 447:     }
 448: 
 449:     /// Backrooms lore made mechanical: holding a walk into solid wall long
 450:     /// enough occasionally phases the player through reality.
 451:     fn update_noclip(&mut self, dt: f32, input: &InputFrame, old_pos: [f32; 3]) {
 452:         self.noclip_cooldown = (self.noclip_cooldown - dt).max(0.0);
 453: 
 454:         let i = input.intent;
 455:         let pushing = input.locked && (i.forward || i.backward || i.left || i.right);
 456:         let dx = self.player.position[0] - old_pos[0];
 457:         let dz = self.player.position[2] - old_pos[2];
 458:         let pinned = pushing && (dx * dx + dz * dz) < 0.002 * 0.002;
 459: 
 460:         if !pinned {
 461:             self.push_seconds = 0.0;
 462:             return;
 463:         }
 464:         self.push_seconds += dt;
 465:         if self.push_seconds < NOCLIP_PUSH_SECONDS || self.noclip_cooldown > 0.0 {
 466:             return;
 467:         }
 468:         self.noclip_cooldown = 1.0;
 469:         if self.rng_next01() < NOCLIP_CHANCE {
 470:             self.noclip();
 471:         }
 472:     }
 473: 
 474:     /// Phase through reality by pushing into walls. From Level 0 the fall is
 475:     /// into the grassland; from anywhere else — including Level 1, exactly
 476:     /// as the wiki warns — a noclip drops the wanderer back into Level 0.
 477:     fn noclip(&mut self) {
 478:         let (target, arrival) = if self.level == LEVEL_BACKROOMS {
 479:             // Into the grassland you phase in place.
 480:             (LEVEL_GRASSLAND, None)
 481:         } else {
 482:             // The way back drops you at the spawn clearing so you can't
 483:             // rematerialize inside a wall.
 484:             (LEVEL_BACKROOMS, Some(self.config.spawn))
 485:         };
 486:         self.switch_level(target, arrival);
 487:     }
 488: 
 489:     /// Switches the active level: drop every resident chunk so the streamer
 490:     /// rebuilds the world from the new level's generator, then optionally
 491:     /// relocate the player to an arrival point in the new coordinate space.
 492:     fn switch_level(&mut self, target: u32, arrival: Option<[f32; 3]>) {
 493:         self.level = target;
 494:         self.store.retain_keys(&[]);
 495:         // In-flight loads are for the old level; their completions will be
 496:         // rejected by the level check, and clearing pending lets the new
 497:         // level re-request the same keys immediately.
 498:         self.pending.clear();
 499:         self.completed_backlog.clear();
 500:         self.forced_reloads.clear();
 501:         // The whole world is regenerated: drop the pool so the next stream
 502:         // pass relayouts and re-uploads from scratch.
 503:         self.pool = AtlasPool::new();
 504:         self.renderer.clear_surfaces();
 505:         self.world.rebuild([].iter());
 506:         self.draws.clear();
 507:         self.push_seconds = 0.0;
 508:         // Flares are world objects of the level they were lit in.
 509:         self.flares.clear();
 510:         // Leaving the level unobserves everything at once: every tracked
 511:         // drift cell rearranges, so phasing out and back never returns the
 512:         // wanderer to the hallways they left.
 513:         let watched: Vec<(i64, i64)> = self.drift_near.drain().collect();
 514:         for (cx, cz) in watched {
 515:             self.reality = self.reality.with_fabric_drift_advanced(cx, cz);
 516:         }
 517:         if let Some(arrival) = arrival {
 518:             self.player.relocate(arrival);
 519:         }
 520:         self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 521:         // The felt air snaps toward the new level's baseline over the
 522:         // ordinary inertia; no need to reset it here.
 523:         self.door_cooldown = DOOR_COOLDOWN_S;
 524:     }

 554:     /// Immutable encounter-state snapshot currently used to key generation.
 555:     /// A later traversal layer will own safe snapshot transitions; exposing
 556:     /// the current value here does not itself mutate or remap the world.
 557:     pub fn reality_snapshot(&self) -> &RealitySnapshot {
 558:         &self.reality
 559:     }
 560: 
 561:     /// Advances the simulation one frame and issues the draw.
 562:     pub fn tick(&mut self, dt_seconds: f32, input: &InputFrame) {
 563:         // Clamp dt so a background-tab hitch can't teleport the player.
 564:         let dt = dt_seconds.clamp(0.0, 0.1);
 565:         self.governor.update(dt_seconds * 1000.0);
 566:         self.time_seconds += dt as f64;
 567: 
 568:         let old_pos = self.player.position;
 569:         if input.locked {
 570:             self.player.apply_look(input.look_dx, input.look_dy);
 571:             self.player.step(dt, &input.intent, &self.world);
 572: 
 573:             // Pedometer: measured here — immediately after the one
 574:             // collision-resolved integration step — so relocations that
 575:             // happen later in the tick (pit recovery, noclip, red-loop
 576:             // handling) and out-of-band teleports can never inflate it.
 577:             // Look input contributes nothing: only position deltas count.
 578:             let dx = self.player.position[0] - old_pos[0];
 579:             let dz = self.player.position[2] - old_pos[2];
 580:             let step = (dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt();
 581:             // Anything faster than sprint speed in one frame is a
 582:             // discontinuity, not walking.
 583:             if step < 1.0 {
 584:                 self.distance_m += step as f64;
 585:             }
 586:         }
 587:         self.update_flares(dt, input);
 588:         self.update_anomalies(old_pos);
 589:         self.update_provisions(dt);
 590:         self.update_peripheral_shift(dt);
 591:         self.update_noclip(dt, input, old_pos);
 592: 
 593:         self.stream_chunks();
 594: 
 595:         // Front-to-back chunk order: the shader marches chunks nearest-first
 596:         // and its per-pixel insertion sort degenerates to a single linear
 597:         // pass when the uniform table is already sorted by camera distance.
 598:         let cam = self.player.position;
 599:         self.draws.sort_by(|a, b| {
 600:             let d2 = |c: &ChunkDraw| {
 601:                 let h = c.world_size * 0.5;
 602:                 let dx = c.origin[0] + h - cam[0];
 603:                 let dy = c.origin[1] + h - cam[1];
 604:                 let dz = c.origin[2] + h - cam[2];
 605:                 dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
 606:             };
 607:             d2(a).total_cmp(&d2(b))
 608:         });
 609: 
 610:         let mut scene_lights = select_scene_lights(
 611:             self.store
 612:                 .iter_ordered()
 613:                 .flat_map(|chunk| chunk.payload.surface.lights.iter()),
 614:             self.player.position,
 615:         );
 616:         // Fluorescent flicker is applied here, once, CPU-side — exactly like
 617:         // flare flicker — so every renderer sees the same fluctuating world
 618:         // and no shader needs a clock.
 619:         let flicker_time = self.time_seconds as f32;
 620:         for light in &mut scene_lights {
 621:             light.intensity *= fixture_flicker_gain(light.id, light.flicker_mode, flicker_time);
 622:         }
 623: 
 624:         // Survival: the lit scene *is* the heat source. The felt ambient
 625:         // chases the instantaneous value with thermal inertia, then the
 626:         // vitals advance under it (heat accelerates thirst).
 627:         let instantaneous_c = thermal::ambient_celsius(
 628:             self.level,
 629:             self.player.position,
 630:             &scene_lights,
 631:             self.world.boxes(),
 632:         );
 633:         let blend = (dt / THERMAL_TAU_S).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 634:         self.ambient_c += (instantaneous_c - self.ambient_c) * blend;
 635:         self.vitals = self.vitals.advanced(dt, self.ambient_c);
 636:         self.auto_consume_supplies();
 637:         if self.vitals.is_dead() {
 638:             self.succumb();
 639:         }
 640:         // Strain: mismanagement in either direction raises the reality's
 641:         // delirium tier, and chunks generated from here on carry more
 642:         // anomalous infill, sealed doorways, shut corridor mouths, and
 643:         // thinner provisions. Resident chunks are untouched — the world
 644:         // worsens as it streams, never as a visible pop. Dehydration bands
 645:         // punish the underconsumer; the excess meter (wasted supplies)
 646:         // punishes the overconsumer with the very same tiers.
 647:         self.excess = (self.excess - dt * EXCESS_DECAY_PER_S).max(0.0);
 648:         let thirst_tier = match self.vitals.hydration {
 649:             h if h > 0.6 => 0,
 650:             h if h > 0.35 => 1,
 651:             h if h > 0.15 => 2,
 652:             _ => 3,
 653:         };
 654:         let excess_tier = match self.excess {
 655:             e if e < 0.25 => 0,
 656:             e if e < 0.5 => 1,
 657:             e if e < 0.75 => 2,
 658:             _ => 3,
 659:         };
 660:         let tier = thirst_tier.max(excess_tier);
 661:         if tier != self.reality.delirium() {
 662:             self.reality = self.reality.with_delirium(tier);
 663:         }
 664: 
 665:         let frame = FrameParams {
 666:             camera_pos: self.player.position,
 667:             yaw: self.player.yaw,
 668:             pitch: self.player.pitch,
 669:             flashlight: input.flashlight,
 670:             dynamic_lights: self.flare_lights(),
 671:             dynamic_light_count: self.flare_light_count(),
 672:             scene_lights,
 673:             environment: self.environment(),
 674:             supply_sprites: self.collect_supply_sprites(),
 675:         };
 676:         self.renderer.draw(&frame, &self.draws);
 677:     }
 678: 
 679:     /// Ages, caps, and drops flares. Placement prefers a spot slightly ahead
 680:     /// of the player's feet but never inside solid geometry; the fallback is
 681:     /// the player's own (guaranteed valid) position.
 682:     fn update_flares(&mut self, dt: f32, input: &InputFrame) {
 683:         for flare in &mut self.flares {
 684:             flare.age_seconds += dt;
 685:         }
 686:         self.flares
 687:             .retain(|flare| flare.age_seconds < FLARE_LIFETIME_S);
 688: 
 689:         if !(input.drop_flare && input.locked) {
 690:             return;
 691:         }
 692:         let fwd = self.player.forward();
 693:         let eye = self.player.position;
 694:         let ahead = [eye[0] + fwd[0] * 0.9, eye[1], eye[2] + fwd[2] * 0.9];
 695:         let spot = if self.world.collides(ahead) {
 696:             eye
 697:         } else {
 698:             ahead
 699:         };
 700:         if self.flares.len() >= FLARE_CAP {
 701:             // Oldest first by construction; no count UI, no modal — the
 702:             // oldest flare simply retires.
 703:             self.flares.remove(0);
 704:         }
 705:         self.flare_sequence += 1;
 706:         self.flares.push(Flare {
 707:             position: [spot[0], FLARE_HEIGHT, spot[2]],
 708:             age_seconds: 0.0,
 709:             sequence: self.flare_sequence,
 710:         });
 711:     }
 712: 
 713:     /// A regenerated chunk may lawfully differ (wake remaps beyond the
 714:     /// eviction ring). A flare standing where new geometry now stands would
 715:     /// desynchronize render and collision, so the deterministic policy is:
 716:     /// remaps never move a flare through a wall — a buried flare is
 717:     /// extinguished the moment the world around it becomes solid.
 718:     fn extinguish_buried_flares(&mut self) {
 719:         if self.flares.is_empty() {
 720:             return;
 721:         }
 722:         let world = &self.world;
 723:         self.flares.retain(|flare| {
 724:             let probe = [
 725:                 flare.position[0],
 726:                 flare.position[1] + 0.2,
 727:                 flare.position[2],
 728:             ];
 729:             !world.boxes().iter().any(|b| Self::point_in_aabb(probe, b))
 730:         });
 731:     }
 732: 
 733:     fn point_in_aabb(p: [f32; 3], b: &crate::application::collision::Aabb) -> bool {
 734:         p[0] >= b.min[0]
 735:             && p[0] <= b.max[0]
 736:             && p[1] >= b.min[1]
 737:             && p[1] <= b.max[1]
 738:             && p[2] >= b.min[2]
 739:             && p[2] <= b.max[2]
 740:     }
 741: 
 742:     /// The nearest active flares as per-frame dynamic lights, distance
 743:     /// culled, with CPU-side flicker and end-of-life fade baked into the
 744:     /// intensity so renderers stay clockless.
 745:     fn flare_lights(&self) -> [DynamicLight; MAX_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS] {
 746:         let mut out = [DynamicLight::default(); MAX_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS];
 747:         for (slot, flare) in self.nearest_flares().into_iter().enumerate() {
 748:             let fade = (flare.remaining_seconds() / (FLARE_LIFETIME_S * 0.1)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 749:             let phase = self.time_seconds as f32 * 13.0 + flare.sequence as f32 * 1.7;
 750:             let flicker = 0.85 + 0.15 * phase.sin() * (phase * 0.37).cos();
 751:             out[slot] = DynamicLight {
 752:                 position: flare.position,
 753:                 color: [1.0, 0.45, 0.18],
 754:                 radius: FLARE_LIGHT_RADIUS,
 755:                 intensity: 1.6 * fade * flicker,
 756:             };
 757:         }
 758:         out
 759:     }
 760: 
 761:     fn flare_light_count(&self) -> u8 {
 762:         self.nearest_flares().len() as u8
 763:     }
 764: 
 765:     fn nearest_flares(&self) -> Vec<&Flare> {
 766:         let cam = self.player.position;
 767:         let mut near: Vec<&Flare> = self
 768:             .flares
 769:             .iter()
 770:             .filter(|f| {
 771:                 let dx = f.position[0] - cam[0];
 772:                 let dz = f.position[2] - cam[2];
 773:                 dx * dx + dz * dz < FLARE_CULL_DISTANCE * FLARE_CULL_DISTANCE
 774:             })
 775:             .collect();
 776:         near.sort_by(|a, b| {
 777:             let d2 = |f: &Flare| {
 778:                 let dx = f.position[0] - cam[0];
 779:                 let dz = f.position[2] - cam[2];
 780:                 dx * dx + dz * dz
 781:             };
 782:             d2(a).total_cmp(&d2(b))
 783:         });
 784:         near.truncate(MAX_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS);
 785:         near
 786:     }
 787: 
 788:     /// Active flares (world-space runtime state), oldest first.
 789:     pub fn flares(&self) -> &[Flare] {
 790:         &self.flares
 791:     }
 792: 
 793:     /// Session pedometer reading in meters.
 794:     pub fn distance_m(&self) -> f32 {
 795:         self.distance_m as f32
 796:     }
 797: 
 798:     /// Squared distance from the player to the nearest point of a chunk's
 799:     /// 2D footprint; 0 inside the chunk. Drives the fine/coarse LOD choice.
 800:     fn chunk_dist2(&self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32) -> f32 {
 801:         let cs = self.config.chunk_size;
 802:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 803:         let dx = (origin_x - px).max(px - (origin_x + cs)).max(0.0);
 804:         let dz = (origin_z - pz).max(pz - (origin_z + cs)).max(0.0);
 805:         dx * dx + dz * dz
 806:     }
 807: 
 808:     fn update_anomalies(&mut self, old_pos: [f32; 3]) {
 809:         if self.level != LEVEL_BACKROOMS {
 810:             self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 811:             return;
 812:         }
 813: 
 814:         let hazards: Vec<_> = self.store.all_pit_hazards().copied().collect();
 815:         if let Some(hazard) = hazards
 816:             .iter()
 817:             .find(|h| h.contains(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]))
 818:         {
 819:             let authored = [
 820:                 hazard.recovery.x,
 821:                 self.player.position[1],
 822:                 hazard.recovery.z,
 823:             ];
 824:             let recovery = if self.world.collides(authored) {
 825:                 self.last_safe_position
 826:             } else {
 827:                 authored
 828:             };
 829:             self.player.relocate(recovery);
 830:             self.last_safe_position = recovery;
 831:             return;
 832:         }
 833: 
 834:         let mut gates: Vec<_> = self.store.all_traversal_gates().copied().collect();
 835:         gates.sort_by_key(|g| g.id);
 836:         gates.dedup_by_key(|g| g.id);
 837:         for gate in gates {
 838:             let Some(direction) = gate.crossing(
 839:                 [old_pos[0], old_pos[2]],
 840:                 [self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]],
 841:             ) else {
 842:                 continue;
 843:             };
 844:             if gate.kind == TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold && direction != gate.forward {
 845:                 continue;
 846:             }
 847:             let next_reality = self.reality.with_advanced_gate(&gate, direction);
 848:             if next_reality == self.reality {
 849:                 continue;
 850:             }
 851:             self.reality = next_reality;
 852: 
 853:             if gate.anomaly_kind == AnomalyKind::RedRoom {
 854:                 // A committed Red Room selects another infinite Level 0
 855:                 // address. Every resident chunk belongs to the old address,
 856:                 // so replacing only the vestibule would splice two realities
 857:                 // at an arbitrary streaming boundary.
 858:                 let targets: Vec<_> = self
 859:                     .store
 860:                     .iter_ordered()
 861:                     .map(|chunk| chunk_key(chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1))
 862:                     .collect();
 863:                 for key in targets {
 864:                     // A pre-threshold refinement for this key is no longer
 865:                     // authoritative; its late completion cannot clear the new
 866:                     // exact request identity.
 867:                     self.pending.remove(&key);
 868:                     self.forced_reloads.insert(key);
 869:                 }
 870:             }
 871:         }
 872:         self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 873:     }
 874: 
 875:     /// Supply pickups and level doors, both exported by generation beside
 876:     /// the geometry. Pickups fold into the reality snapshot (a consumed
 877:     /// bottle never regenerates); doors switch the streamed level.
 878:     fn update_provisions(&mut self, dt: f32) {
 879:         self.door_cooldown = (self.door_cooldown - dt).max(0.0);
 880:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 881: 
 882:         // -- pickups ---------------------------------------------------------
 883:         // Halo overlap can surface the same item from two chunks; dedupe by
 884:         // id so one bottle never quenches twice.
 885:         let mut grabbed: Vec<_> = self
 886:             .store
 887:             .all_supply_items()
 888:             .filter(|item| {
 889:                 item.within_reach(px, pz, PICKUP_REACH)
 890:                     && !self.reality.supply_consumed(item.id)
 891:             })
 892:             .copied()
 893:             .collect();
 894:         grabbed.sort_by_key(|item| item.id);
 895:         grabbed.dedup_by_key(|item| item.id);
 896:         for item in grabbed {
 897:             self.reality = self.reality.with_supply_consumed(item.id);
 898:             match item.kind {
 899:                 SupplyKind::AlmondWater => {
 900:                     if self.vitals.hydration < 0.98 || self.almond_bottles >= CARRY_CAP {
 901:                         self.register_waste(self.vitals.hydration, ALMOND_WATER_HYDRATION);
 902:                         self.vitals = self.vitals.drank_almond_water();
 903:                     } else {
 904:                         self.almond_bottles += 1;
 905:                     }
 906:                 }
 907:                 SupplyKind::Ration => {
 908:                     if self.vitals.satiety < 0.98 || self.rations >= CARRY_CAP {
 909:                         self.register_waste(self.vitals.satiety, RATION_SATIETY);
 910:                         self.vitals = self.vitals.ate_ration();
 911:                     } else {
 912:                         self.rations += 1;
 913:                     }
 914:                 }
 915:             }
 916:             // Rebuild the chunk holding the marker under the advanced
 917:             // reality so the bottle visibly leaves the world.
 918:             let cs = self.config.chunk_size;
 919:             let key = chunk_key(
 920:                 (item.position.x / cs).floor() * cs,
 921:                 (item.position.z / cs).floor() * cs,
 922:             );
 923:             self.pending.remove(&key);
 924:             self.forced_reloads.insert(key);
 925:         }
 926: 
 927:         // -- level doors ------------------------------------------------------
 928:         if self.door_cooldown > 0.0 {
 929:             return;
 930:         }
 931:         let transit = self
 932:             .store
 933:             .all_level_exits()
 934:             .find(|exit| exit.contains(px, pz))
 935:             .copied();
 936:         if let Some(exit) = transit {
 937:             let arrival = [
 938:                 exit.arrival.x,
 939:                 self.player.position[1],
 940:                 exit.arrival.z,
 941:             ];
 942:             self.switch_level(exit.target_level, Some(arrival));
 943:         }
 944:     }
 945: 
 946:     /// The nearest unconsumed supply labels, ready for billboard drawing.
 947:     /// Labels float a little above the marker so the logo reads over the
 948:     /// bottle/tin voxels.
 949:     pub fn collect_supply_sprites(&self) -> Vec<crate::application::ports::SupplySprite> {
 950:         use crate::application::ports::{MAX_SUPPLY_SPRITES, SupplySprite};
 951:         const LABEL_CULL: f32 = 14.0;
 952:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 953:         let mut near: Vec<(f32, SupplySprite)> = self
 954:             .store
 955:             .all_supply_items()
 956:             .filter(|item| !self.reality.supply_consumed(item.id))
 957:             .filter_map(|item| {
 958:                 let dx = item.position.x - px;
 959:                 let dz = item.position.z - pz;
 960:                 let d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
 961:                 (d2 < LABEL_CULL * LABEL_CULL).then_some((
 962:                     d2,
 963:                     SupplySprite {
 964:                         position: [item.position.x, item.rest_y + 0.62, item.position.z],
 965:                         atlas_row: match item.kind {
 966:                             SupplyKind::AlmondWater => 0,
 967:                             SupplyKind::Ration => 1,
 968:                         },
 969:                     },
 970:                 ))
 971:             })
 972:             .collect();
 973:         near.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0));
 974:         // Halo overlap can list one item twice; identical positions dedupe.
 975:         near.dedup_by(|a, b| a.1 == b.1);
 976:         near.truncate(MAX_SUPPLY_SPRITES);
 977:         near.into_iter().map(|(_, sprite)| sprite).collect()
 978:     }
 979: 
 980:     /// Consumes carried supplies once their vital runs low. Even here a
 981:     /// little restoration overshoots the full mark, and the overshoot is
 982:     /// booked as waste — a small, honest cost next to the gluttony of
 983:     /// drinking at a full reserve.
 984:     fn auto_consume_supplies(&mut self) {
 985:         if self.vitals.hydration < AUTO_CONSUME_AT && self.almond_bottles > 0 {
 986:             self.almond_bottles -= 1;
 987:             self.register_waste(self.vitals.hydration, ALMOND_WATER_HYDRATION);
 988:             self.vitals = self.vitals.drank_almond_water();
 989:         }
 990:         if self.vitals.satiety < AUTO_CONSUME_AT && self.rations > 0 {
 991:             self.rations -= 1;
 992:             self.register_waste(self.vitals.satiety, RATION_SATIETY);
 993:             self.vitals = self.vitals.ate_ration();
 994:         }
 995:     }
 996: 
 997:     /// Books the unused share of a consumed supply onto the excess meter.
 998:     fn register_waste(&mut self, reserve_before: f32, restores: f32) {
 999:         let waste = (reserve_before + restores - 1.0).max(0.0);
1000:         self.excess = (self.excess + waste * EXCESS_PER_WASTE).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
1001:     }
1002: 
1003:     /// Death by attrition: the wanderer wakes at the level's arrival point
1004:     /// with reset vitals and empty pockets. The world — drift, consumed
1005:     /// supplies, sealed rooms — remembers everything.
1006:     fn succumb(&mut self) {
1007:         self.deaths += 1;
1008:         self.vitals = PlayerVitals::default();
1009:         self.almond_bottles = 0;
1010:         self.rations = 0;
1011:         let spawn = level_spawn(self.level, self.config.spawn);
1012:         self.player.relocate(spawn);
1013:         self.last_safe_position = spawn;
1014:     }
1015: 
1016:     /// Squared distance from a point to a drift cell's world rectangle
1017:     /// (0 inside the cell).
1018:     fn drift_cell_dist2(cell: (i64, i64), px: f32, pz: f32) -> f32 {
1019:         let x0 = cell.0 as f32 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL;
1020:         let z0 = cell.1 as f32 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL;
1021:         let dx = (x0 - px).max(px - (x0 + FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL)).max(0.0);
1022:         let dz = (z0 - pz).max(pz - (z0 + FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL)).max(0.0);
1023:         dx * dx + dz * dz
1024:     }
1025: 
1026:     /// Every drift cell any resident chunk could touch counts as observed.
1027:     /// The far radius adds hysteresis of a couple of cells, so a cell only
1028:     /// drifts once the player has genuinely abandoned it.
1029:     fn drift_near_radius(&self) -> f32 {
1030:         (self.visual_policy.radius as f32 + 1.0) * self.config.chunk_size
1031:     }
1032: 
1033:     /// Dehydration, 0 provisioned .. 1 parched.
1034:     fn dehydration(&self) -> f32 {
1035:         (1.0 - self.vitals.hydration).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
1036:     }
1037: 
1038:     /// Mismanagement, 0 careful .. 1 ruinous — the world's aggression dial:
1039:     /// more thirst *or* more waste, more shift, more anomaly.
1040:     fn mismanagement(&self) -> f32 {
1041:         self.dehydration().max(self.excess)
1042:     }
1043: 
1044:     fn drift_far_radius(&self) -> f32 {
1045:         // A mismanaging wanderer loses the hysteresis: the fabric rearranges
1046:         // almost the moment it leaves the streaming footprint.
1047:         self.drift_near_radius() + 2.0 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL * (1.0 - 0.85 * self.mismanagement())
1048:     }
1049: 
1050:     /// The Peripheral Shift: "whenever not directly observed, the layout can
1051:     /// warp, stretch, or rearrange itself."
1052:     ///
1053:     /// Tier 1 — abandoned territory. Cells the player walks near are marked;
1054:     /// when one falls beyond the far radius every chunk of it has long been
1055:     /// evicted, its drift epoch advances, and whatever streams back in later
1056:     /// is a lawfully different warren (corridors, assemblies, and anomalies
1057:     /// never move — navigation survives; hallway memory does not).
1058:     ///
1059:     /// Tier 2 — inside a blackout the shift stalks the player in real time:
1060:     /// on a slow cadence, cells that lie entirely behind the player's facing,
1061:     /// beyond what any light could reveal, and fully inside the blackout's
1062:     /// bounds advance immediately and their resident chunks rebuild. The
1063:     /// darkness hides the swap; turning around is never a way back.
1064:     fn update_peripheral_shift(&mut self, dt: f32) {
1065:         if self.level != LEVEL_BACKROOMS {
1066:             return;
1067:         }
1068:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
1069: 
1070:         // -- tier 1: mark near cells, drift abandoned ones -------------------
1071:         let near = self.drift_near_radius();
1072:         let min_cx = fabric_drift_cell_of(px - near);
1073:         let max_cx = fabric_drift_cell_of(px + near);
1074:         let min_cz = fabric_drift_cell_of(pz - near);
1075:         let max_cz = fabric_drift_cell_of(pz + near);
1076:         for cz in min_cz..=max_cz {
1077:             for cx in min_cx..=max_cx {
1078:                 if Self::drift_cell_dist2((cx, cz), px, pz) <= near * near {
1079:                     self.drift_near.insert((cx, cz));
1080:                 }
1081:             }
1082:         }
1083:         let far2 = self.drift_far_radius() * self.drift_far_radius();
1084:         let abandoned: Vec<(i64, i64)> = self
1085:             .drift_near
1086:             .iter()
1087:             .copied()
1088:             .filter(|&cell| Self::drift_cell_dist2(cell, px, pz) > far2)
1089:             .collect();
1090:         for cell in abandoned {
1091:             self.drift_near.remove(&cell);
1092:             self.reality = self.reality.with_fabric_drift_advanced(cell.0, cell.1);
1093:         }
1094: 
1095:         // -- tier 2: the blackout rearranges behind the player ---------------
1096:         self.blackout_shift_cooldown = (self.blackout_shift_cooldown - dt).max(0.0);
1097:         let blackout_bounds = self
1098:             .store
1099:             .all_traversal_gates()
1100:             .find(|gate| {
1101:                 gate.anomaly_kind == AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse
1102:                     && gate.affected_bounds.contains(px, pz)
1103:             })
1104:             .map(|gate| gate.affected_bounds);
1105:         let Some(bounds) = blackout_bounds else {
1106:             self.blackout_shift_debug.0 = false;
1107:             return;
1108:         };
1109:         self.blackout_shift_debug.0 = true;
1110:         if self.blackout_shift_cooldown > 0.0 {
1111:             return;
1112:         }
1113:         let forward = self.player.forward();
1114:         // The rear shift reaches past the streaming footprint on purpose:
1115:         // cells it advances beyond residency simply rebuild on approach,
1116:         // exactly like tier-1 drift.
1117:         let reach = self.drift_near_radius().max(3.0 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL);
1118:         let mut shifted = Vec::new();
1119:         for cz in fabric_drift_cell_of(pz - reach)..=fabric_drift_cell_of(pz + reach) {
1120:             for cx in fabric_drift_cell_of(px - reach)..=fabric_drift_cell_of(px + reach) {
1121:                 let cx_w = (cx as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL;
1122:                 let cz_w = (cz as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL;
1123:                 // Center-based checks on purpose: a 40 u cell near the
1124:                 // blackout's edge or the player's flank still shifts. The
1125:                 // sliver a check this loose can expose sits in blackout
1126:                 // darkness — and a half-glimpsed wall that wasn't there is
1127:                 // the intended experience, not a bug.
1128:                 let inside = bounds.contains(cx_w, cz_w);
1129:                 let behind =
1130:                     (cx_w - px) * forward[0] + (cz_w - pz) * forward[2] < -4.0;
1131:                 let hidden =
1132:                     Self::drift_cell_dist2((cx, cz), px, pz) > BLACKOUT_HIDE_DISTANCE.powi(2);
1133:                 if inside && behind && hidden {
1134:                     shifted.push((cx, cz));
1135:                 }
1136:             }
1137:         }
1138:         self.blackout_shift_debug = (true, shifted.len(), self.blackout_shift_debug.2);
1139:         if shifted.is_empty() {
1140:             return;
1141:         }
1142:         self.blackout_shift_debug.2 += shifted.len();
1143:         // Mismanagement accelerates the stalking dark: at full strain the
1144:         // rear shift fires three times as often.
1145:         self.blackout_shift_cooldown =
1146:             BLACKOUT_SHIFT_PERIOD_S / (1.0 + 2.0 * self.mismanagement());
1147:         for &(cx, cz) in &shifted {
1148:             self.reality = self.reality.with_fabric_drift_advanced(cx, cz);
1149:         }
1150:         // Rebuild the resident chunks of the shifted cells in place. The
1151:         // install path's player-overlap check keeps the swap safe, and the
1152:         // request carries the advanced reality by construction.
1153:         let cell_bounds: Vec<WorldBounds> = shifted
1154:             .iter()
1155:             .map(|&(cx, cz)| {
1156:                 WorldBounds::new(
1157:                     cx as f32 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL,
1158:                     cz as f32 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL,
1159:                     (cx + 1) as f32 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL,
1160:                     (cz + 1) as f32 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL,
1161:                 )
1162:             })
1163:             .collect();
1164:         let cs = self.config.chunk_size;
1165:         let targets: Vec<ChunkKey> = self
1166:             .store
1167:             .iter_ordered()
1168:             .filter(|chunk| {
1169:                 let rect = WorldBounds::new(
1170:                     chunk.origin.0,
1171:                     chunk.origin.1,
1172:                     chunk.origin.0 + cs,
1173:                     chunk.origin.1 + cs,
1174:                 );
1175:                 cell_bounds.iter().any(|cell| cell.intersects(rect))
1176:             })
1177:             .map(|chunk| chunk_key(chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1))
1178:             .collect();
1179:         for key in targets {
1180:             self.pending.remove(&key);
1181:             self.forced_reloads.insert(key);
1182:         }
1183:     }
1184: 
1185:     fn make_request_for(
1186:         &mut self,
1187:         origin_x: f32,
1188:         origin_z: f32,
1189:         lod: u8,
1190:         reality: RealitySnapshot,
1191:     ) -> ChunkRequest {
1192:         let request_id = self.next_request_id;
1193:         self.next_request_id = self.next_request_id.wrapping_add(1);
1194:         if self.next_request_id == 0 {
1195:             self.next_request_id = 1;
1196:         }
1197:         ChunkRequest {
1198:             request_id,
1199:             origin_x,
1200:             origin_z,
1201:             level: self.level,
1202:             lod,
1203:             reality,
1204:         }
1205:     }
1206: 
1207:     fn make_request(&mut self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32, lod: u8) -> ChunkRequest {
1208:         self.make_request_for(origin_x, origin_z, lod, self.reality.clone())
1209:     }
1210: 
1211:     /// Installs finished background loads, discarding stale work: a result
1212:     /// for the wrong level (noclip happened), for a chunk that left the
1213:     /// streaming footprint, or for a LOD no better than what is already
1214:     /// resident. Refinement stays monotonic exactly like the sync path.
1215:     ///
1216:     /// Installs are metered by the same per-tick cost budget as synchronous
1217:     /// loads (coarse = 1, fine = `FINE_LOAD_COST`): when a burst of worker
1218:     /// results lands in one frame, the overflow waits in
1219:     /// `completed_backlog` instead of stacking mesh uploads and collision
1220:     /// rebuilds into a single frame.
1221:     fn install_completed(
1222:         &mut self,
1223:         keep: &[ChunkKey],
1224:         loaded: &mut Vec<ChunkKey>,
1225:         changed: &mut bool,
1226:     ) {
1227:         // A transport failure is not a completion, but it must retire the
1228:         // exact pending order or that chunk can never be scheduled again.
1229:         // Old worker callbacks cannot cancel a newer retry because request
1230:         // identity includes the engine-assigned monotonic id and reality.
1231:         for failed in self.source.poll_failed_requests() {
1232:             let key = chunk_key(failed.origin_x, failed.origin_z);
1233:             let is_current = self
1234:                 .pending
1235:                 .get(&key)
1236:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(&failed));
1237:             if is_current {
1238:                 self.pending.remove(&key);
1239:             }
1240:         }
1241: 
1242:         let fresh = self.source.poll_completed();
1243:         self.completed_backlog.extend(fresh);
1244:         let mut budget = (self.config.max_loads_per_tick as u32 * FINE_LOAD_COST).max(1);
1245:         let mut deferred: Vec<CompletedChunk> = Vec::new();
1246:         for done in self.completed_backlog.drain(..).collect::<Vec<_>>() {
1247:             let install_cost = if done.request.lod == 0 {
1248:                 FINE_LOAD_COST
1249:             } else {
1250:                 1
1251:             };
1252:             if budget < install_cost {
1253:                 deferred.push(done);
1254:                 continue;
1255:             }
1256:             let req = &done.request;
1257:             let key = chunk_key(req.origin_x, req.origin_z);
1258:             // A completion is authoritative only while the exact order it
1259:             // echoes is still pending. In particular, an old result for the
1260:             // same chunk must not remove a newer pending request.
1261:             let is_current = self
1262:                 .pending
1263:                 .get(&key)
1264:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(req));
1265:             if !is_current {
1266:                 continue;
1267:             }
1268:             self.pending.remove(&key);
1269:             if req.level != self.level || !keep.contains(&key) {
1270:                 continue;
1271:             }
1272:             let is_forced = self.forced_reloads.contains(&key);
1273:             let improves = match self.store.get(key) {
1274:                 None => true,
1275:                 // LOD is monotonic only inside one exact reality. A chunk
1276:                 // from a replaced reality is replaced even if its old LOD was
1277:                 // finer; comparing their LODs would preserve stale geometry.
1278:                 Some(resident) if resident.is_in_reality(&req.reality) => req.lod < resident.lod,
1279:                 Some(_) => is_forced,
1280:             };
1281:             if !improves {
1282:                 continue;
1283:             }
1284:             if is_forced {
1285:                 let player = player_aabb(self.player.position);
1286:                 if done
1287:                     .payload
1288:                     .collision
1289:                     .iter()
1290:                     .any(|solid| solid.intersects(&player))
1291:                 {
1292:                     // Safety beats the effect: keep the old resident reality
1293:                     // but do not abandon the transition. Defer this chunk and
1294:                     // restore its pending status so we try again next tick.
1295:                     self.pending.insert(key, req.clone());
1296:                     deferred.push(done);
1297:                     continue;
1298:                 }
1299:             }
1300:             budget -= install_cost;
1301:             self.store.insert(
1302:                 key,
1303:                 LoadedChunk::new(
1304:                     (req.origin_x, req.origin_z),
1305:                     req.lod,
1306:                     req.reality.clone(),
1307:                     done.payload,
1308:                 ),
1309:             );
1310:             if !loaded.contains(&key) {
1311:                 loaded.push(key);
1312:             }
1313:             *changed = true;
1314:             self.forced_reloads.remove(&key);
1315:         }
1316:         self.completed_backlog = deferred;
1317:         // Drop pending entries that left the footprint so their slots free
1318:         // up; a late completion for them is discarded by the keep check.
1319:         self.pending
1320:             .retain(|key, request| keep.contains(key) && request.level == self.level);
1321:     }
1322: 
1323:     /// Tops up the background request queue: coarse availability for every
1324:     /// missing chunk (nearest first), then at most one fine refinement in
1325:     /// flight at a time, mirroring the sync path's priorities.
1326:     fn issue_requests(&mut self, desired: &[(f32, f32)], desired_visual: &[(f32, f32)]) {
1327:         // Keep roughly a worker pool's worth of requests in flight; more
1328:         // would just build a stale backlog behind a moving player.
1329:         let max_pending = (self.config.max_loads_per_tick * 2).max(4);
1330: 
1331:         let forced: Vec<_> = self
1332:             .forced_reloads
1333:             .iter()
1334:             .filter_map(|&key| {
1335:                 self.store
1336:                     .get(key)
1337:                     .map(|chunk| (key, chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1, chunk.lod))
1338:             })
1339:             .collect();
1340:         for (key, ox, oz, lod) in forced {
1341:             if self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
1342:                 break;
1343:             }
1344:             if !self.pending.contains_key(&key) {
1345:                 let request = self.make_request(ox, oz, lod);
1346:                 self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
1347:                 self.source.request(request);
1348:             }
1349:         }
1350: 
1351:         for &(ox, oz) in desired_visual {
1352:             if self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
1353:                 break;
1354:             }
1355:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
1356:             if !self.store.contains(key) && !self.pending.contains_key(&key) {
1357:                 let request = self.make_request(ox, oz, COARSE_LOD);
1358:                 self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
1359:                 self.source.request(request);
1360:             }
1361:         }
1362: 
1363:         let fine_in_flight = self.pending.values().any(|request| request.lod == 0);
1364:         if fine_in_flight || self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
1365:             return;
1366:         }
1367:         let fine_d2 = self.config.fine_distance * self.config.fine_distance;
1368:         let target = desired.iter().copied().find(|&(ox, oz)| {
1369:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
1370:             self.chunk_dist2(ox, oz) <= fine_d2
1371:                 && !self.pending.contains_key(&key)
1372:                 && self.store.get(key).is_some_and(|c| c.lod > 0)
1373:         });
1374:         if let Some((ox, oz)) = target {
1375:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
1376:             let resident_reality = self.store.get(key).unwrap().reality.clone();
1377:             let request = self.make_request_for(ox, oz, 0, resident_reality);
1378:             self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
1379:             self.source.request(request);
1380:         }
1381:     }
1382: 
1383:     /// Progressive, error-driven chunk streaming.
1384:     ///
1385:     /// Availability first: every missing chunk (nearest first) loads at the
1386:     /// cheap coarse LOD, so the whole footprint renders before any chunk is
1387:     /// refined. Refinement second: with leftover budget, the nearest
1388:     /// resident coarse chunk within `fine_distance` reloads at full
1389:     /// resolution in place. Chunks beyond `fine_distance` stay coarse — at
1390:     /// that range a coarse voxel projects to about a fine voxel's pixels —
1391:     /// and refinement is monotonic while resident, so there is no flapping.
1392:     ///
1393:     /// Both phases share one per-tick cost budget (coarse = 1 unit, fine =
1394:     /// `FINE_LOAD_COST`), keeping the worst-case tick at the old cost of
1395:     /// `max_loads_per_tick` fine loads. Newly loaded and refined chunks
1396:     /// upload only their own atlas slot rows; a full re-upload only happens
1397:     /// on pool relayouts (first load, bigger chunks, level switch) or on
1398:     /// back ends without partial-update support.
1399:     fn stream_chunks(&mut self) {
1400:         let surface_renderer = self.renderer.uses_surface_meshes();
1401:         let desired = self
1402:             .policy
1403:             .desired_origins(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
1404:         let desired_visual = self
1405:             .visual_policy
1406:             .desired_origins(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
1407:         let keep: Vec<_> = desired_visual
1408:             .iter()
1409:             .map(|&(x, z)| chunk_key(x, z))
1410:             .collect();
1411: 
1412:         // Free the atlas slots of chunks about to be evicted.
1413:         let evicted: Vec<ChunkKey> = self
1414:             .store
1415:             .iter_ordered()
1416:             .map(|c| chunk_key(c.origin.0, c.origin.1))
1417:             .filter(|k| !keep.contains(k))
1418:             .collect();
1419:         let mut changed = self.store.retain_keys(&keep);
1420:         self.forced_reloads.retain(|key| keep.contains(key));
1421:         if surface_renderer {
1422:             if !evicted.is_empty() {
1423:                 self.renderer.remove_surfaces(&evicted);
1424:             }
1425:         } else {
1426:             for key in evicted {
1427:                 self.pool.release(key);
1428:             }
1429:         }
1430: 
1431:         let mut loaded: Vec<ChunkKey> = Vec::new();
1432:         if self.source.is_async() {
1433:             // Background pipeline: install validated completions, then top
1434:             // up the request queue. The frame never blocks on generation.
1435:             self.install_completed(&keep, &mut loaded, &mut changed);
1436:             self.issue_requests(&desired, &desired_visual);
1437:         } else {
1438:             let mut budget = self.config.max_loads_per_tick as u32 * FINE_LOAD_COST;
1439: 
1440:             // Red-room closure is a semantic transition, not ordinary LOD
1441:             // work. Rebuild the small affected set first and install each
1442:             // complete payload atomically across its geometry/collision/light
1443:             // views. The threshold bend keeps this set out of direct sight.
1444:             let forced: Vec<_> = self
1445:                 .forced_reloads
1446:                 .iter()
1447:                 .filter_map(|&key| {
1448:                     self.store
1449:                         .get(key)
1450:                         .map(|c| (key, c.origin.0, c.origin.1, c.lod))
1451:                 })
1452:                 .collect();
1453:             for (key, ox, oz, lod) in forced {
1454:                 let payload = self
1455:                     .source
1456:                     .load_with_reality(ox, oz, self.level, lod, &self.reality);
1457:                 let player = player_aabb(self.player.position);
1458:                 if payload
1459:                     .collision
1460:                     .iter()
1461:                     .any(|solid| solid.intersects(&player))
1462:                 {
1463:                     self.forced_reloads.remove(&key);
1464:                     continue;
1465:                 }
1466:                 self.store.insert(
1467:                     key,
1468:                     LoadedChunk::new((ox, oz), lod, self.reality.clone(), payload),
1469:                 );
1470:                 self.forced_reloads.remove(&key);
1471:                 loaded.push(key);
1472:                 changed = true;
1473:             }
1474: 
1475:             // Phase 1 — availability: missing chunks come in coarse, nearest
1476:             // first. Only a leftover budget flows into refinement, so a moving
1477:             // player always fills holes before sharpening anything.
1478:             for &(ox, oz) in &desired_visual {
1479:                 if budget == 0 {
1480:                     break;
1481:                 }
1482:                 let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
1483:                 if !self.store.contains(key) {
1484:                     let payload = self.source.load_with_reality(
1485:                         ox,
1486:                         oz,
1487:                         self.level,
1488:                         COARSE_LOD,
1489:                         &self.reality,
1490:                     );
1491:                     self.store.insert(
1492:                         key,
1493:                         LoadedChunk::new((ox, oz), COARSE_LOD, self.reality.clone(), payload),
1494:                     );
1495:                     loaded.push(key);
1496:                     budget -= 1;
1497:                     changed = true;
1498:                 }
1499:             }
1500: 
1501:             // Phase 2 — refinement: nearest coarse chunk inside the fine ring.
1502:             let fine_d2 = self.config.fine_distance * self.config.fine_distance;
1503:             while budget >= FINE_LOAD_COST {
1504:                 let target = desired.iter().copied().find(|&(ox, oz)| {
1505:                     self.chunk_dist2(ox, oz) <= fine_d2
1506:                         && self.store.get(chunk_key(ox, oz)).is_some_and(|c| c.lod > 0)
1507:                 });
1508:                 let Some((ox, oz)) = target else { break };
1509:                 let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
1510:                 let resident_reality = self.store.get(key).unwrap().reality.clone();
1511:                 let payload =
1512:                     self.source
1513:                         .load_with_reality(ox, oz, self.level, 0, &resident_reality);
1514:                 self.store.insert(
1515:                     key,
1516:                     LoadedChunk::new((ox, oz), 0, resident_reality, payload),
1517:                 );
1518:                 if !loaded.contains(&key) {
1519:                     loaded.push(key);
1520:                 }
1521:                 budget -= FINE_LOAD_COST;
1522:                 changed = true;
1523:             }
1524:         }
1525: 
1526:         if !changed {
1527:             return;
1528:         }
1529: 
1530:         // The default path uploads only changed/replaced meshes. It keeps
1531:         // the SVO payload in memory for collision and exact debug queries,
1532:         // but avoids atlas rebasing and per-pixel traversal entirely.
1533:         if surface_renderer {
1534:             let surface_updates: Vec<SurfaceChunk<'_>> = loaded
1535:                 .iter()
1536:                 .filter_map(|&key| {
1537:                     self.store.get(key).map(|chunk| SurfaceChunk {
1538:                         key,
1539:                         origin: [chunk.origin.0, 0.0, chunk.origin.1],
1540:                         mesh: &chunk.payload.surface,
1541:                     })
1542:                 })
1543:                 .collect();
1544:             if !surface_updates.is_empty() {
1545:                 self.renderer.upload_surfaces(&surface_updates);
1546:             }
1547: 
1548:             self.draws.clear();
1549:             for chunk in self.store.iter_ordered() {
1550:                 self.draws.push(ChunkDraw {
1551:                     origin: [chunk.origin.0, 0.0, chunk.origin.1],
1552:                     root_index: 0,
1553:                     world_size: chunk.payload.world_size,
1554:                     voxel_size: chunk.payload.voxel_size,
1555:                     svo_depth: chunk.payload.svo_depth,
1556:                 });
1557:             }
1558:             self.draws.truncate(MAX_CHUNKS);
1559:             self.atlas_nodes = self
1560:                 .store
1561:                 .iter_ordered()
1562:                 .map(|c| c.payload.nodes.len() / 4)
1563:                 .sum();
1564:             let boxes: Vec<_> = self.store.all_collision_boxes().copied().collect();
1565:             self.world.rebuild(boxes.iter());
1566:             self.extinguish_buried_flares();
1567:             return;
1568:         }
1569: 
1570:         // Size the pool for the streaming footprint and the largest chunk.
1571:         let num_slots = ((2 * self.policy.radius + 1).pow(2) as usize).min(MAX_CHUNKS);
1572:         let rows = self
1573:             .store
1574:             .iter_ordered()
1575:             .map(|c| payload_rows(&c.payload))
1576:             .max()
1577:             .unwrap_or(1)
1578:             .max(1);
1579:         let mut need_full = self.pool.ensure_layout(num_slots, rows);
1580: 
1581:         if !need_full {
1582:             for &key in &loaded {
1583:                 let uploaded = match self.pool.assign(key) {
1584:                     Some(slot) => {
1585:                         let payload = &self.store.get(key).expect("just inserted").payload;
1586:                         let block = self.pool.rebased_block(slot, payload);
1587:                         let first_row = self.pool.slot_first_row(slot) as u32;
1588:                         self.renderer.upload_atlas_rows(first_row, &block)
1589:                     }
1590:                     None => false,
1591:                 };
1592:                 if !uploaded {
1593:                     need_full = true;
1594:                     break;
1595:                 }
1596:             }
1597:         }
1598: 
1599:         if need_full {
1600:             let keys: Vec<ChunkKey> = self
1601:                 .store
1602:                 .iter_ordered()
1603:                 .map(|c| chunk_key(c.origin.0, c.origin.1))
1604:                 .collect();
1605:             for key in keys {
1606:                 let _ = self.pool.assign(key);
1607:             }
1608:             let texels = self
1609:                 .pool
1610:                 .full_texels(|k| self.store.get(k).map(|c| &c.payload));
1611:             self.renderer.upload_atlas(&texels);
1612:         }
1613: 
1614:         self.draws.clear();
1615:         for chunk in self.store.iter_ordered() {
1616:             let key = chunk_key(chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1);
1617:             if let Some(offset) = self.pool.node_offset_of(key) {
1618:                 self.draws.push(ChunkDraw {
1619:                     origin: [chunk.origin.0, 0.0, chunk.origin.1],
1620:                     root_index: (offset + chunk.payload.root as usize) as i32,
1621:                     world_size: chunk.payload.world_size,
1622:                     voxel_size: chunk.payload.voxel_size,
1623:                     svo_depth: chunk.payload.svo_depth,
1624:                 });
1625:             }
1626:         }
1627:         self.draws.truncate(MAX_CHUNKS);
1628:         self.atlas_nodes = self
1629:             .store
1630:             .iter_ordered()
1631:             .map(|c| c.payload.nodes.len() / 4)
1632:             .sum();
1633: 
1634:         let boxes: Vec<_> = self.store.all_collision_boxes().copied().collect();
1635:         self.world.rebuild(boxes.iter());
1636:         self.extinguish_buried_flares();
1637:     }

1661:     /// Multi-line plain-text report of the live anomaly machinery, for the
1662:     /// debug overlay: reality-snapshot epochs, resident traversal gates and
1663:     /// pit hazards (nearest first), and the streaming pipeline counters.
1664:     /// Pure formatting over engine state — no browser types, natively
1665:     /// testable.
1666:     pub fn anomaly_debug_text(&self) -> String {
1667:         use std::fmt::Write;
1668:         let p = self.player.position;
1669:         let mut out = String::with_capacity(1024);
1670:         let _ = writeln!(
1671:             out,
1672:             "pos ({:.1}, {:.1}, {:.1})  level {}  yaw {:.2}",
1673:             p[0], p[1], p[2], self.level, self.player.yaw
1674:         );
1675:         let _ = writeln!(
1676:             out,
1677:             "chunks {} resident ({} fine) | pending {} | backlog {} | forced reloads {}",
1678:             self.store.len(),
1679:             self.store.iter_ordered().filter(|c| c.lod == 0).count(),
1680:             self.pending.len(),
1681:             self.completed_backlog.len(),
1682:             self.forced_reloads.len(),
1683:         );
1684:         let _ = writeln!(
1685:             out,
1686:             "flares {} | push {:.2}s",
1687:             self.flares.len(),
1688:             self.push_seconds
1689:         );
1690: 
1691:         let stamps = self.reality.stamps();
1692:         let _ = writeln!(out, "reality: {} stamp(s)", stamps.len());
1693:         let _ = writeln!(
1694:             out,
1695:             "peripheral shift: {} drifted cell(s), {} watched",
1696:             self.reality.fabric_drifts().len(),
1697:             self.drift_near.len()
1698:         );
1699:         let (inside, eligible, total) = self.blackout_shift_debug;
1700:         let _ = writeln!(
1701:             out,
1702:             "blackout shift: inside={inside} eligible={eligible} \
1703:              shifted_total={total} cooldown={:.1}s",
1704:             self.blackout_shift_cooldown
1705:         );
1706:         for stamp in stamps {
1707:             let _ = writeln!(
1708:                 out,
1709:                 "  {:016x} epoch {}  plane {:.1} {:?} {:?}",
1710:                 stamp.instance_id,
1711:                 stamp.epoch,
1712:                 stamp.gate_plane(),
1713:                 stamp.gate_axis,
1714:                 stamp.travel_direction,
1715:             );
1716:         }
1717: 
1718:         let mut gates: Vec<_> = self.store.all_traversal_gates().copied().collect();
1719:         gates.sort_by_key(|g| g.id);
1720:         gates.dedup_by_key(|g| g.id);
1721:         gates.sort_by(|a, b| {
1722:             let d = |g: &vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGate| match g.axis {
1723:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::X => (g.plane - p[0]).abs(),
1724:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::Z => (g.plane - p[2]).abs(),
1725:             };
1726:             d(a).total_cmp(&d(b))
1727:         });
1728:         let _ = writeln!(out, "gates resident: {}", gates.len());
1729:         for gate in gates.iter().take(6) {
1730:             let dist = match gate.axis {
1731:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::X => (gate.plane - p[0]).abs(),
1732:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::Z => (gate.plane - p[2]).abs(),
1733:             };
1734:             let epoch = self.reality.lookup(gate.instance_id).map_or(0, |s| s.epoch);
1735:             let _ = writeln!(
1736:                 out,
1737:                 "  {:?}/{:?} of {:?} {:08x}  plane {:.1} on {:?}  d={:.1}  epoch {}",
1738:                 gate.kind,
1739:                 gate.forward,
1740:                 gate.anomaly_kind,
1741:                 (gate.instance_id & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32,
1742:                 gate.plane,
1743:                 gate.axis,
1744:                 dist,
1745:                 epoch,
1746:             );
1747:         }
1748: 
1749:         let mut pits: Vec<_> = self.store.all_pit_hazards().copied().collect();
1750:         pits.sort_by_key(|h| h.id);
1751:         pits.dedup_by_key(|h| h.id);
1752:         pits.sort_by(|a, b| {
1753:             let d = |h: &vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::PitHazard| {
1754:                 let dx = h.center.x - p[0];
1755:                 let dz = h.center.z - p[2];
1756:                 dx * dx + dz * dz
1757:             };
1758:             d(a).total_cmp(&d(b))
1759:         });
1760:         let _ = writeln!(out, "pit hazards resident: {}", pits.len());
1761:         for pit in pits.iter().take(4) {
1762:             let dx = pit.center.x - p[0];
1763:             let dz = pit.center.z - p[2];
1764:             let _ = writeln!(
1765:                 out,
1766:                 "  {:08x} at ({:.1}, {:.1})  half {:.1}  d={:.1}  recovery ({:.1}, {:.1})",
1767:                 (pit.id & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32,
1768:                 pit.center.x,
1769:                 pit.center.z,
1770:                 pit.half_side,
1771:                 (dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt(),
1772:                 pit.recovery.x,
1773:                 pit.recovery.z,
1774:             );
1775:         }
1776:         out
1777:     }

1779:     pub fn stats(&self) -> HudStats {
1780:         let spawn_key = chunk_key(
1781:             (self.config.spawn[0] / self.config.chunk_size).floor() * self.config.chunk_size,
1782:             (self.config.spawn[2] / self.config.chunk_size).floor() * self.config.chunk_size,
1783:         );
1784:         HudStats {
1785:             resident_chunks: self.store.len(),
1786:             fine_chunks: self.store.iter_ordered().filter(|c| c.lod == 0).count(),
1787:             atlas_nodes: self.atlas_nodes,
1788:             collision_boxes: self.world.len(),
1789:             resolution_scale: self.governor.scale(),
1790:             ready: self.store.contains(spawn_key),
1791:             distance_m: self.distance_m as f32,
1792:             hydration: self.vitals.hydration,
1793:             satiety: self.vitals.satiety,
1794:             condition: self.vitals.condition,
1795:             almond_bottles: self.almond_bottles,
1796:             rations: self.rations,
1797:             ambient_c: self.ambient_c,
1798:             deaths: self.deaths,
1799:             level: self.level,
1800:         }
1801:     }
1802: }

1815:     /// Synchronous source whose every chunk carries one almond water beside
1816:     /// the spawn and one door to Level 1 a few steps away.

1819:     impl ChunkSourcePort for ProvisionedChunkSource {
1820:         fn load(&self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32, level: u32, _lod: u8) -> ChunkPayload {
1821:             let in_chunk = |x: f32, z: f32| {
1822:                 x >= origin_x && x < origin_x + 10.0 && z >= origin_z && z < origin_z + 10.0
1823:             };
1824:             let mut supply_items = vec![];
1825:             let mut level_exits = vec![];
1826:             if level == 0 && in_chunk(5.0, 5.0) {
1827:                 supply_items.push(SupplyItem {
1828:                     id: 41,
1829:                     kind: SupplyKind::AlmondWater,
1830:                     position: Position::new(5.2, 5.2),
1831:                     rest_y: 0.0,
1832:                 });
1833:                 level_exits.push(LevelExit {
1834:                     id: 90,
1835:                     target_level: 1,
1836:                     center: Position::new(8.0, 5.0),
1837:                     half_extent: 0.7,
1838:                     arrival: Position::new(3.0, 3.0),
1839:                 });
1840:             }
1841:             ChunkPayload {
1842:                 root: 0,
1843:                 nodes: [1u32, 0, 0, 0].repeat(1024),
1844:                 world_size: 12.8,
1845:                 voxel_size: 0.2,
1846:                 svo_depth: 6,
1847:                 surface: crate::application::ports::SurfaceMeshPayload::empty(0),
1848:                 collision: vec![],
1849:                 traversal_gates: vec![],
1850:                 pit_hazards: vec![],
1851:                 supply_items,
1852:                 level_exits,
1853:             }
1854:         }
1855:     }

1857:     fn provisioned_engine() -> Engine {
1858:         Engine::new(
1859:             EngineConfig::default(),
1860:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
1861:             Box::new(ProvisionedChunkSource),
1862:         )

1865:     #[test]
1866:     fn pickup_folds_into_reality_and_quenches_or_stocks() {
1867:         let mut engine = provisioned_engine();
1868:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1869:         // Tick 1 streams the spawn chunk; tick 2 grabs the bottle at reach.
1870:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1871:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1872:         assert!(engine.reality_snapshot().supply_consumed(41));
1873:         // Fresh vitals are near-full, so the bottle is carried, not drunk.
1874:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().almond_bottles, 1);
1875: 
1876:         // The carried bottle is drunk the moment thirst runs low.
1877:         engine.set_vitals_for_test(PlayerVitals {
1878:             hydration: 0.2,
1879:             satiety: 0.9,
1880:             condition: 0.9,
1881:         });
1882:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1883:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().almond_bottles, 0);
1884:         assert!(engine.vitals().hydration > 0.5, "auto-drink restored thirst");
1885:     }
1886: 
1887:     #[test]
1888:     fn stepping_through_a_door_switches_to_level_one_and_back_is_possible() {
1889:         let mut engine = provisioned_engine();
1890:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1891:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1892:         assert_eq!(engine.level(), 0);
1893: 
1894:         // Walk the player into the door trigger between ticks (the tick
1895:         // itself only integrates real input; the test moves the eye).
1896:         engine.player.relocate([8.0, 1.7, 5.0]);
1897:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1898:         assert_eq!(engine.level(), 1, "door transit must fire");
1899:         // Arrival is the authored Level 1 plaza point.
1900:         assert_eq!(engine.player.position[0], 3.0);
1901:         assert_eq!(engine.player.position[2], 3.0);
1902:         // The world was flushed and re-streamed from the new level's
1903:         // generator within the same tick (synchronous source).
1904:         assert!(engine.stats().resident_chunks > 0);
1905:     }

1936:     #[derive(Default)]
1937:     struct RecordingRenderer {
1938:         uploads: Rc<RefCell<Vec<usize>>>,
1939:         row_uploads: Rc<RefCell<Vec<u32>>>,
1940:         draws: Rc<RefCell<Vec<usize>>>,
1941:         /// When true the renderer accepts partial row updates like the GPU
1942:         /// driver; when false it forces the full-upload fallback.
1943:         supports_rows: bool,
1944:     }
1945: 
1946:     impl RendererPort for RecordingRenderer {
1947:         fn upload_atlas(&mut self, texels: &[u32]) {
1948:             self.uploads.borrow_mut().push(texels.len());
1949:         }
1950:         fn upload_atlas_rows(&mut self, first_row: u32, _texels: &[u32]) -> bool {
1951:             if self.supports_rows {
1952:                 self.row_uploads.borrow_mut().push(first_row);
1953:             }
1954:             self.supports_rows
1955:         }
1956:         fn draw(&mut self, _frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
1957:             self.draws.borrow_mut().push(chunks.len());
1958:         }
1959:     }
1960: 
1961:     #[derive(Default)]
1962:     struct SurfaceRecordingRenderer {
1963:         atlas_uploads: Rc<RefCell<usize>>,
1964:         surface_uploads: Rc<RefCell<Vec<usize>>>,
1965:         removed: Rc<RefCell<Vec<usize>>>,
1966:     }
1967: 
1968:     impl RendererPort for SurfaceRecordingRenderer {
1969:         fn uses_surface_meshes(&self) -> bool {
1970:             true
1971:         }
1972:         fn upload_surfaces(&mut self, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) {
1973:             self.surface_uploads.borrow_mut().push(chunks.len());
1974:         }
1975:         fn remove_surfaces(&mut self, keys: &[crate::application::ports::SurfaceChunkKey]) {
1976:             self.removed.borrow_mut().push(keys.len());
1977:         }
1978:         fn upload_atlas(&mut self, _texels: &[u32]) {
1979:             *self.atlas_uploads.borrow_mut() += 1;
1980:         }
1981:         fn draw(&mut self, _frame: &FrameParams, _chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {}
1982:     }

2029:     /// Background source double: records requests, completes only what the
2030:     /// test explicitly finishes, and panics on any blocking load.
2031:     #[derive(Default)]
2032:     struct AsyncFakeSource {
2033:         requests: Rc<RefCell<Vec<ChunkRequest>>>,
2034:         ready: Rc<RefCell<Vec<crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk>>>,
2035:         failed: Rc<RefCell<Vec<ChunkRequest>>>,
2036:     }
2037: 
2038:     impl ChunkSourcePort for AsyncFakeSource {
2039:         fn load(&self, _x: f32, _z: f32, _level: u32, _lod: u8) -> ChunkPayload {
2040:             unreachable!("async sources must never be block-loaded by the engine");
2041:         }
2042:         fn is_async(&self) -> bool {
2043:             true
2044:         }
2045:         fn request(&mut self, request: ChunkRequest) {
2046:             self.requests.borrow_mut().push(request);
2047:         }
2048:         fn poll_completed(&mut self) -> Vec<crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk> {
2049:             self.ready.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect()
2050:         }
2051:         fn poll_failed_requests(&mut self) -> Vec<ChunkRequest> {
2052:             self.failed.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect()
2053:         }
2054:     }
2055: 
2056:     fn completed(request: ChunkRequest) -> crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk {
2057:         let payload = FlatChunkSource.load(
2058:             request.origin_x,
2059:             request.origin_z,
2060:             request.level,
2061:             request.lod,
2062:         );
2063:         crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk { request, payload }
2064:     }
2065: 
2066:     fn test_request(
2067:         request_id: u32,
2068:         origin_x: f32,
2069:         origin_z: f32,
2070:         level: u32,
2071:         lod: u8,
2072:     ) -> ChunkRequest {
2073:         ChunkRequest {
2074:             request_id,
2075:             origin_x,
2076:             origin_z,
2077:             level,
2078:             lod,
2079:             reality: RealitySnapshot::default(),
2080:         }
2081:     }

2083:     #[test]
2084:     fn async_source_streams_without_blocking_and_refines_monotonically() {
2085:         let source = AsyncFakeSource::default();
2086:         let requests = source.requests.clone();
2087:         let ready = source.ready.clone();
2088:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
2089:             EngineConfig::default(),
2090:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
2091:             Box::new(source),
2092:         );
2093:         let input = InputFrame::default();
2094: 
2095:         // First tick issues requests but installs nothing — the frame
2096:         // never waits for generation.
2097:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2098:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 0);
2099:         assert!(!engine.stats().ready);
2100:         assert!(!requests.borrow().is_empty());
2101: 
2102:         // Fulfil whatever is asked until the footprint is fine everywhere.
2103:         for _ in 0..40 {
2104:             let fulfil: Vec<_> = requests.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect();
2105:             for req in fulfil {
2106:                 ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(req));
2107:             }
2108:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2109:         }
2110:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 9);
2111:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 9);
2112:         assert!(engine.stats().ready);
2113: 
2114:         // Steady state: no further requests.
2115:         let before = requests.borrow().len();
2116:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2117:         assert_eq!(requests.borrow().len(), before);
2118:     }

2123:         let ready = source.ready.clone();

2126:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),

2128:         );

2130:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2131: 
2132:         // A worst-case burst: fine results for all nine footprint chunks
2133:         // land in the same frame.
2134:         let desired = engine
2135:             .policy
2136:             .desired_origins(engine.player.position[0], engine.player.position[2]);
2137:         let mut id = 90_000;

2142:             ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(req));

2145:         // Budget: max_loads_per_tick (2) fine-equivalents per tick, so the
2146:         // burst spreads over ceil(9 / 2) ticks instead of hitching one frame.
2147:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);

2152:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2153:         }

2276:         failed.borrow_mut().push(first.clone());

2286:             requests

2293:         failed.borrow_mut().push(first);

2295:         assert!(
2296:             engine
2297:                 .pending
2298:                 .get(&key)
2299:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(&retry)),
2300:             "a late failure for the old order must preserve its current retry"
2301:         );
2302:         assert!(requests.borrow().is_empty(), "no duplicate may be queued");

2372:     #[test]
2373:     fn streams_coarse_first_then_refines_nearest_first() {
2374:         let (mut engine, uploads, _draws) = engine_with_recorder();
2375:         let input = InputFrame::default();
2376: 
2377:         // 9 chunks are desired (radius 1). The per-tick budget is
2378:         // max_loads_per_tick * FINE_LOAD_COST = 8 units; a coarse load costs
2379:         // 1, a fine load 4. Tick 1: eight coarse loads — the world is
2380:         // visible (and `ready`) after one tick instead of five.
2381:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2382:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 8);
2383:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 0);
2384:         assert!(engine.stats().ready, "coarse spawn chunk flips ready");
2385: 
2386:         // Tick 2: the last coarse load + one refinement. Ticks 3-6: two
2387:         // refinements each; every chunk is within fine_distance (15) here.
2388:         for expected_fine in [1usize, 3, 5, 7, 9] {
2389:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2390:             assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 9);
2391:             assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, expected_fine);
2392:         }
2393:         assert_eq!(uploads.borrow().len(), 6, "one upload per changed tick");
2394: 
2395:         // Subsequent ticks should not load anything or re-upload.
2396:         for _ in 0..5 {
2397:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2398:         }
2399:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 9);
2400:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 9);
2401:         assert_eq!(uploads.borrow().len(), 6);
2402:     }

2513:     /// Tier 1 of the Peripheral Shift: walking far from a neighborhood
2514:     /// advances its drift epoch, so the fabric that streams back in later is
2515:     /// keyed to a different reality — while the territory around the player
2516:     /// stays exactly as observed.
2517:     #[test]
2518:     fn abandoned_territory_gains_a_fabric_drift_epoch() {
2519:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
2520:             EngineConfig::default(),
2521:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
2522:             Box::new(FlatChunkSource),
2523:         );
2524:         let input = InputFrame::default();
2525:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2526:         assert!(
2527:             engine.reality.fabric_drifts().is_empty(),
2528:             "nothing may drift while the player stands in it"
2529:         );
2530:         let origin_cell = (
2531:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::fabric_drift_cell_of(5.0),
2532:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::fabric_drift_cell_of(5.0),
2533:         );
2534:         assert!(engine.drift_near.contains(&origin_cell));
2535: 
2536:         // Abandon the spawn neighborhood entirely.
2537:         engine.player.relocate([500.0, 1.7, 500.0]);
2538:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2539:         assert!(
2540:             engine
2541:                 .reality
2542:                 .fabric_drift_epoch(5.0, 5.0)
2543:                 >= 1,
2544:             "abandoned territory must rearrange"
2545:         );
2546:         assert_eq!(
2547:             engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(500.0, 500.0),
2548:             0,
2549:             "the territory around the player never drifts"
2550:         );
2551:         // Returning and leaving again drifts it again.
2552:         engine.player.relocate([5.0, 1.7, 5.0]);
2553:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2554:         let first = engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(5.0, 5.0);
2555:         engine.player.relocate([500.0, 1.7, 500.0]);
2556:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2557:         assert_eq!(engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(5.0, 5.0), first + 1);
2558:     }
