2560:     /// Tier 2: inside a blackout, cells wholly behind the player and beyond
2561:     /// any light's reach shift in real time and their chunks force-rebuild.
2562:     /// The space ahead and everything outside the blackout hold still.
2563:     #[test]
2564:     fn blackout_shifts_the_space_behind_the_player_while_inside() {
2565:         use vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::{
2566:             AnomalyKind, Axis2, AxisDirection, TraversalGate, TraversalGateKind, WorldBounds,
2567:         };
2568:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
2569:             EngineConfig::default(),
2570:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
2571:             Box::new(FlatChunkSource),
2572:         );
2573:         let gate = TraversalGate {
2574:             id: 11,
2575:             instance_id: 401,
2576:             anomaly_kind: AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse,
2577:             kind: TraversalGateKind::Remap,
2578:             axis: Axis2::X,
2579:             plane: 0.0,
2580:             span_min: -200.0,
2581:             span_max: 200.0,
2582:             forward: AxisDirection::Positive,
2583:             affected_bounds: WorldBounds::new(-200.0, -200.0, 200.0, 200.0),
2584:         };
2585:         let mut payload = FlatChunkSource.load(0.0, 0.0, 0, 0);
2586:         payload.traversal_gates.push(gate);
2587:         engine.store.insert(
2588:             chunk_key(0.0, 0.0),
2589:             LoadedChunk::new((0.0, 0.0), 0, RealitySnapshot::empty(), payload),
2590:         );
2591:         // A resident chunk in the rear cell (player at z=5 facing -Z: the
2592:         // cell z in [40, 80) is wholly behind and beyond the hide distance).
2593:         engine.store.insert(
2594:             chunk_key(0.0, 40.0),
2595:             LoadedChunk::new(
2596:                 (0.0, 40.0),
2597:                 0,
2598:                 RealitySnapshot::empty(),
2599:                 FlatChunkSource.load(0.0, 40.0, 0, 0),
2600:             ),
2601:         );
2602:         engine.player.position = [5.0, 1.7, 5.0];
2603:         engine.player.yaw = 0.0; // forward = -Z
2604:         engine.update_peripheral_shift(1.0 / 60.0);
2605: 
2606:         assert!(
2607:             engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(5.0, 60.0) >= 1,
2608:             "the cell behind the player must shift"
2609:         );
2610:         assert_eq!(
2611:             engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(5.0, -60.0),
2612:             0,
2613:             "the cell ahead of the player must hold still"
2614:         );
2615:         assert!(
2616:             engine.forced_reloads.contains(&chunk_key(0.0, 40.0)),
2617:             "resident chunks of the shifted cell must rebuild"
2618:         );
2619:         // The cadence gate: an immediate second pass changes nothing more.
2620:         let stamps = engine.reality.fabric_drifts().len();
2621:         engine.update_peripheral_shift(1.0 / 60.0);
2622:         assert_eq!(engine.reality.fabric_drifts().len(), stamps);

2635:         let gate = TraversalGate {
2636:             id: 7,
2637:             instance_id: 99,
2638:             anomaly_kind: AnomalyKind::RedRoom,
2639:             kind: TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold,
2640:             axis: Axis2::X,
2641:             plane: 5.0,
2642:             span_min: 0.0,
2643:             span_max: 10.0,
2644:             forward: AxisDirection::Positive,
2645:             affected_bounds: WorldBounds::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0),
2646:         };
2647:         let mut payload = FlatChunkSource.load(0.0, 0.0, 0, 0);
2648:         payload.traversal_gates.push(gate);
2649:         engine.store.insert(
2650:             chunk_key(0.0, 0.0),
2651:             LoadedChunk::new((0.0, 0.0), 0, RealitySnapshot::empty(), payload),
2652:         );
2653:         engine.store.insert(
2654:             chunk_key(20.0, 0.0),
2655:             LoadedChunk::new(
2656:                 (20.0, 0.0),
2657:                 0,
2658:                 RealitySnapshot::empty(),
2659:                 FlatChunkSource.load(20.0, 0.0, 0, 0),
2660:             ),
2661:         );
2662:         engine.player.position = [6.0, 1.7, 5.0];
2663:         engine.update_anomalies([4.0, 1.7, 5.0]);
2664:         assert_eq!(engine.reality.lookup(99).unwrap().epoch, 1);
2665:         assert!(engine.forced_reloads.contains(&chunk_key(0.0, 0.0)));
2666:         assert!(
2667:             engine.forced_reloads.contains(&chunk_key(20.0, 0.0)),
2668:             "a distant resident must not remain in the base Level 0 address"
2669:         );
2670: 
2671:         // Crossing the same directional threshold outward is not closure.
2672:         let before = engine.reality.clone();
2673:         engine.player.position = [4.0, 1.7, 5.0];
2674:         engine.update_anomalies([6.0, 1.7, 5.0]);
2675:         assert_eq!(engine.reality, before);
2676:     }

2708:     #[test]
2709:     fn pushing_into_a_wall_eventually_noclips_to_the_grassland() {
2710:         let levels = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Vec::new()));
2711:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
2712:             EngineConfig::default(),
2713:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
2714:             Box::new(TrappingChunkSource {
2715:                 levels: levels.clone(),
2716:             }),
2717:         );
2718:         assert_eq!(engine.level(), 0);
2719: 
2720:         // Hold forward into the wall. 20% per roll, one roll per second of
2721:         // pushing: 120 simulated seconds without a switch is ~1e-11 likely.
2722:         let input = InputFrame {
2723:             intent: crate::application::player::MoveIntent {
2724:                 forward: true,
2725:                 ..Default::default()
2726:             },
2727:             locked: true,
2728:             ..Default::default()
2729:         };
2730:         let mut switched_at = None;
2731:         for tick in 0..(120 * 60) {
2732:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2733:             if engine.level() != 0 {
2734:                 switched_at = Some(tick);
2735:                 break;
2736:             }
2737:         }
2738:         assert_eq!(
2739:             engine.level(),
2740:             34,
2741:             "never noclipped (switched_at={switched_at:?})"
2742:         );
2743:         // New chunks must be requested for the grassland level.
2744:         for _ in 0..5 {
2745:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2746:         }
2747:         assert!(
2748:             levels.borrow().iter().any(|&l| l == 34),
2749:             "chunk source never asked for level 34: {:?}",
2750:             levels.borrow()
2751:         );
2752:     }

2790:     #[test]
2791:     fn governor_locks_out_raises_after_a_failed_probe() {
2792:         let mut governor = PerfGovernor::new();
2793:         for _ in 0..300 {
2794:             governor.update(16.7); // raises to 1.0 almost immediately
2795:         }
2796:         assert_eq!(governor.scale(), 1.0);
2797:         for _ in 0..600 {
2798:             governor.update(40.0); // raise fails: overloaded at 1.0
2799:         }
2800:         assert!(governor.scale() < 1.0);
2801:         let settled = governor.scale();
2802:         for _ in 0..600 {
2803:             governor.update(16.7); // healthy again, but inside the lockout
2804:         }
2805:         assert_eq!(governor.scale(), settled, "raise must stay locked out");
2806:     }
2807: }
